chapters.title: Chapter 1751: Reunion With Lady Wu
paragraphs: From the start of the auction to the end, Lady Wu had been anticipating what she would do when she finally came face to face with Kent.
Even before the auction began, she had already figured out that the mysterious man who came with Veth and Flura was Kent.
She knew deep in her heart that the only man Veth or Flura would allow to touch them in the whole universe and beyond was Kent. She had the same mindset as them after all.
So when she learned they had come with a man, she suspected it was him, and it quickly turned out to be true.
However, after planning thousands of ways to approach him, when she finally set her sights on him, all she could do was hug him and bury her face in his chest.
The world around them, which included her sisters, had already vanished, leaving her alone with Kent, who wore a smile as he hugged her.
It had been years since they had last seen each other, so it was only natural for this reunion to be an emotional one.
After a few minutes of heartfelt hugging, Lady Wu finally pulled back and locked eyes with Kent, tears falling down her face.
Kent simply hugged her again to calm her beating heart.
After another few minutes, she relaxed, and this time she managed to utter a single word.

Kent smiled and brushed a few strands of hair from her face. "It is okay, Lady Wu. I know it has been thousands of years since we last saw each other, and I apologize for the delay. However, I am here now, so instead of dwelling on the past, we have to focus on the future and what it has in store for us."
Lady Wu nodded.
Well, the kind of feelings she had for Kent would never make her stay mad at him.

Kent had already told them that several thousand years would pass before they met again. However, they never expected it to be more than 370,000 years. In their minds, they thought it would only be a few tens of thousands of years.
So they missed him.
For someone like Lady Wu, whose feelings for Kent had only started to resurface before they parted ways, she had suffered for years trying to come to terms with everything.
Now, Kent had returned, and all she could do was be happy.
"How have you been, Lady Wu?" Kent asked, and she smiled before answering.
"As you have seen, I managed to realize my dream of owning one of the biggest auction empires in the universe. I achieved it all thanks to your investment in my dream."
Kent smiled. "Congratulations, then, and just so you know, I knew you could do it even without my help."

She was business-smart, so with or without Kent’s help, she would have managed somehow. However, Kent’s investment had sped up the process. Now, she owned the largest and most prestigious auction house in the entire Eastern Region and perhaps all of the Immortal Realm.
"I am proud of you, Lady Wu," Kent said before letting go of her.
They would have plenty of time to catch up. For now, he wanted her to catch up with her sisters and then handle the transactions involved.
Kent had won some bids, and so had Flura and Veth, so those had to be settled first. Afterward, they could return to the Tower and catch up properly.
Again, Kent kept a close eye on the Fatty, who was eating his last meal. He had already marked him for death, so for now, he could dine to his heart’s content. His end was nigh.

But while Kent had finally reunited with one of the ladies he had met during his travels through the Pill Worlds, word of his battle and eventual killing of the Primal God had begun to spread far and wide.
While this universe was not technologically inclined, news circulated much faster than one might think.
Formations had become so advanced that one could speak to someone thousands of light-years away with nothing more than a simple channeling of energy.
So word spread, and soon it reached an outpost of the Primal Temple located in the Eastern Region of the Immortal Realm.
Kent had no idea the Primal Temple had a presence in the Immortal Realm, but even if he had known, he would not have compromised.
When he fought the Forsaken Race, he did it to satisfy his own personal vendetta. They had killed his one true love, so he sought revenge.
However, when he learned that the Arcane Order, now known as the Primal Temple, was the true culprit, he pursued them as someone determined to rid the universe of its greatest horror.
However, he had underestimated the extent of their power. They later unleashed the Void Race upon everyone, and that led to the fall of the Primordial Era.
He failed to stop them, and during the Divine Era, they unleashed the Foreign Race upon everyone once again. Painfully, he failed to stop them again, resulting in the deaths of countless people.
However, he managed to learn something that made no sense to him at the time. Now, after many eras had passed, he seemed to have gained a much better understanding of what it truly meant.

"This universe is merely an infant that needs to grow. If it remains an infant, we will all be shackled to the rank of Celestials, stagnating our potential. So it must grow, and the only way to do that is for it to surrender to a true power."
Those were the words spoken by the Primal God he had interrogated, and back then, Kent did not fully understand them.
But he did now, and that alone made him realize that the Primal Temple was the true enemy, not the Void Beasts, Shadow Creatures, or any of the other horrors that had once invaded the universe.
He had also discovered that while many races had attacked the universe in the past, the ones coming now were the real threat.
Kent knew he had to free the First Undead Generals, who had already clashed with them once and emerged victorious, so he could learn more.
The Primal Temple would undoubtedly be the reason that danger found this universe again, and so Kent planned to reduce their numbers to a pitiful level before that time came.
"Bastard!"
An Elven man with flowing green hair smashed his fist onto a jade table, shattering it completely.
His name was Thorne, the leader of the Primal Temple in the Eastern Immortal Region. He had just received news that one of their members had been killed by Kent Madson.
While it sounded too unbelievable to be true, as someone tasked with gathering information on Kent Madson, he knew and believed that bastard had indeed killed one of their own.

The thought made him grit his teeth, but he had to report it to the higher-ups first. Of course, he had no intention of letting Kent live, so he planned to go after him regardless of what the higher-ups decided.
He walked into a room where a crystal ball floated in midair, emitting faint divine qi.
The moment he approached it, he pressed his palm against it, and a few seconds later, he found his consciousness standing at the center of a grand hall surrounded by hundreds of gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1752: Primal Temple Decision
paragraphs: While the Primal Temple was not that dominant in the Immortal Realm, they had quite a foothold in the God Realm, the Supreme Realm, and the Celestial Realm.
They were one of the major powers in the god realm.
Whenever decisions had to be made, they were mostly made in one of their temples.
Today, everyone had gathered to address a more pressing issue they had recently noticed. This issue had to do with Sahir, the Supreme Ice Mage’s return.
Sahir had already made it to the Celestial Realm and announced his return.
While Sahir wasn’t an issue for the Primal Gods in the God Realm, they knew they would eventually be affected.
After all, to them, the greatest threat to this universe was its heroes, and Sahir was once one of those heroes. His return wasn’t welcomed at all.

So all the Primal Gods were busy at work, making sure their plans weren’t derailed by the appearance of an old enemy. Unfortunately for them, things didn’t pan out as expected when news reached them that the person they had been after for a while had killed one of their own.
They initially wanted Kent to join them, but things are different now.
"How did it happen?" a Primal God asked, staring angrily at the Elven man who was the leader of the Primal Temple Xylarahi was a member of.

"She went to an auction at one of the famous auction houses in the Immortal Realm. According to the reports, the last item auctioned was the infamous flame technique known as the Finger of Destruction.
The second form was put up for auction by the Flame Demon Clan, and she placed a bid for it.
However, Kent Madson also wanted it, and despite knowing who Xylarahi was and her backing, he didn’t care and bought it. So she attacked him, and he ended up killing her without mercy.
The report emphasized that Kent Madson seems to hate Primal Gods the most, and more shockingly, he even knows about the Arcane Order."
"WHAT..."
Every last Primal God in the hall gasped, some even jumping to their feet.
"Are you sure he explicitly mentioned the name Arcane Order?" one of them asked, and the Elven man nodded.
"Yes. According to the report, he only attacked after asking that question."
"Then it appears we have someone who knows about our past identity."
"He cannot be allowed to live for long. If word got out that the Primal Temple was actually the famed Arcane Order, our reputation would hit rock bottom."
"That is indeed true. He must be killed before it is too late."
"Such a pity. Having such a talent among us would have sped up our plans. However, since he has revealed himself to be an enemy, he must die."
A few seconds of silence passed before one of them spoke.
"The request for his death must be sent to all Primal God Temples. Contact our allies, the Soul Temple and Silent Nights, as well. He cannot be allowed to live for long."
"I vote we put a pin in the discussion concerning the Supreme Ice Mage and focus on addressing this more important matter."
Thus, orders were sent out, and thousands of gods went into overdrive, working to locate the person whose existence now threatened them to their very core.
Word soon reached the Supreme Realm and the Celestial Realm. Just like the decisions made in the God Realm, they all wanted Kent gone, and so they made their move.
[A week after the Auction - God Realm - Pill God Brandon’s POV]

A man with handsome features slammed his palm against a cauldron, leaving a deep dent in its surface. His expression was so twisted with rage that his handsome facial features were almost hidden behind his scowl.
Standing not far from him was a god whose body barely showed any signs of life. This god was Axten Zul, the same person who had led a team of gods to attack Pill God Flura during her Pill Ceremony.
They had gone there to threaten her on the orders of Pill God Brandon, but Kent had stopped them and, using Ixeron, ensured his insults and warnings were delivered exactly as he intended.

Just now, Axten Zul had finally returned to the God Realm and arrived at Pill God Brandon’s private world, where Ixeron’s brain-manipulation implant activated and said everything it had been programmed to say.
"Bastard," Pill God Brandon cursed, his eyes bloodshot.
After unloading those insults on him, Kent had even declared that he would challenge him to a duel someday. That alone was enough to fuel Brandon’s fury.

As one of the greatest Pill Gods in the universe, he deserved the respect he had earned. But it appeared Kent had no such intentions. He had made sure Brandon understood exactly what kind of person he was and what he truly intended to do.
Hearing the commotion, five Universal Gods appeared in the room where Pill God Brandon was.
"My lord, is everything alright?" one of them asked.
"Do I look alright to you, bastard?" Pill God Brandon snapped, his fists clenched.
The Universal God, who had asked the question, immediately apologized and bowed.
Clearly, his master was furious, and it was evident from both his expression and his voice.
A few minutes later, Pill God Brandon finally managed to calm himself down before speaking.
"Send out the order. Whoever manages to kill or capture Kent Madson will receive a God Pill from me.
"I don’t care what methods they use. As long as he is captured or killed, I will fulfill my promise."
And just like that, another powerhouse had placed a bounty on Kent’s head, adding to the already staggering number of threats looming over him.
This time, his name spread throughout the universe, but those who took action were far from righteous people.
The Soul Temple had dispatched its agents to hunt him down.
The Silent Night, the only assassin organization in the universe that rivaled the Midnight Shadows, had also dispatched assassins to hunt him down.
Many others wanted a piece of him, but the man whose life was being threatened didn’t seem fazed in the slightest.

To Kent, he had reached a stage in his life where mere threats from immortals and gods no longer fazed him. While there were still gods capable of threatening him and Supremes capable of killing him, he wasn’t afraid of any of them.
This wasn’t because recovering Fjorge’s memories had made him unbeatable. Rather, it was because he had begun to sense changes within himself that seemed to originate from all kinds of places.
When Unity, Dia, and Lilian completed their mission, he felt it.
Then Enzi, Liora, and Princess Lovina completed theirs, and he felt himself grow stronger once again.
Aside from them, he could also sense that whenever his Beast Legion and Eternal Wrath Legion cleared a dungeon, his own strength increased.
While he wasn’t yet at the point where fighting dozens of gods at the same time was feasible, he was fast enough to escape from them while killing a few along the way.
On top of that, his combat strength had risen to the point where he estimated that once he ascended to the Demigod stage, even a few Supremes would be destined to die if they fought him.
In short, ordinary gods could no longer kill him, and even the Supremes would find it difficult to catch him.
As for whether that assessment was true or not, his upcoming mission to the Flame Paradise would provide the answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 1753: Revenge is best served Barbecued
paragraphs: [Three days after the auction]
After reuniting with Lady Wu and paying for everything he had won at the auction, Kent returned to the tower with the three ladies.

Lady Wu wanted to handle everything with her own money, but Kent refused since he wanted to fulfill a quest. Aside from that, he informed Lady Khronisia from the Blacksmith association that she should give him 5 days.
She accepted, and Kent dispatched 10 shadow fiends to protect her while he was away.
When he returned, he discovered that Liora and her team had completed their mission and had even returned with over seven million Sand Demons.
Kent was a bit shaken when he saw the millions of Sand Demons now occupying Nagaraja, one of the cities unoccupied until they came.
Gaia and her team had built it for occasions when an impromptu migration is needed, and they can’t put something up in that short a time.
To congratulate his three wives on a job well done, Kent spent a month with them inside the harem tower. His three wives had done well, so he made sure they felt appreciated.
While that was happening, Lady Wu was also getting acquainted with some of Kent’s wives and the various races inside the tower.
Every last being inside the tower sees Kent as their savior and his wives as their rulers, so they made sure she was introduced to everyone.
Kent saw that she needed time to adjust to her new life, so he didn’t move forward with officially making her his woman just yet. That time would come eventually.

After he was done spending time with Enzi, Liora, and Princess Lovina, he left the tower to handle the rescue of the slave girl, who also happened to be one of the most unreasonable people he had met during his incarnation as Fjorge, the Nine Underworld Flame Blacksmith.
It had already been three days since the auction.

The ship that the Fatty had boarded was still traveling through the space channel, traveling at an incredible speed. Kent already had a spy aboard the ship, so when he was ready, he merely willed it, and a portal appeared.
However, unlike how he could instantly teleport to the side of his wives and legions, the Shadow Fiends take some time to work.
Even so, he wasn’t in a rush, so five minutes later, inside a room aboard the ship, Kent stepped out of the portal, startling the very person he had intended to see first.
"Whoa, easy there, young lady." Kent raised both hands as the tip of a spear pressed against his throat.
"You..." She blinked several times, perhaps to make sure her eyes weren’t deceiving her. "Kent Madson?"
It turned out her eyes weren’t deceiving her at all, but she was still in disbelief.
Kent smiled and replied, "In the flesh."
His expression showed he wasn’t the least bit bothered by the spear pressed against his throat.
"Perhaps you should move the pointy thing away from my throat first."
The young lady quickly lowered her spear and apologized.
"I am sorry. I never knew Lord Deckins had invited you aboard the ship."
"Oh, he didn’t invite me. I came of my own accord," Kent grinned, seeing the stunned expression on her face. "...To kill him."
The spear rose again, but Kent grabbed it and pulled it away. The young lady was merely an Immortal King, so she was no match for Kent, who could fight gods.
"Relax, young lady. I am here to kill your master. If anything, you should be thrilled."

"I will die before I let you touch Lord Deckins!" she shouted, struggling to pull the spear back. However, Kent’s grip was firm, making her struggle futile. Even so, he could tell she genuinely wanted to kill him.
This made Kent sigh and frown slightly.
"So that is how things are, huh?"
It appeared that with the slave collar on, even if she wanted her master dead, the moment his life was threatened, she would be compelled to protect him.
Right now, all she wanted was to kill Kent and protect her master. It wasn’t even a matter of resisting the collar anymore. She simply wanted to kill Kent.
"Go to sleep, and when you wake up, you will be free."
Kent’s hand moved, and the next second, she passed out. He carried her to the nearby bed and laid her on it. Then his expression turned icy.
"Time to feel my anger, Fatty."
The Soul Map opened, and inside a dining hall, the greasy bastard was happily tearing into a chunk of meat. Kent sneered, then, with a single step, appeared inside the dining hall.
The maids serving the Fatty instantly felt something invade their minds, and they all passed out.
"Who is—"
Lord Deckins was about to shout when his gaze landed on Kent. At once, he recognized him, but the moment he saw the cold look in Kent’s eyes, panic set in, and the meat in his hand fell to the floor.

"I am going to kill you very slowly and very painfully. Now, I want you to scream as much as you like, because for the next twenty-four hours, pain beyond anything you ever thought possible will overwhelm your senses."
Kent took one step, and the chair the Fatty was sitting on shattered, sending him crashing to the floor.
The mansion trembled, and the guards stationed around rushed forward.
However, they all came to an abrupt halt when shadows materialized, forming a line of deadly Demigod-level Shadow Fiends.
None of them would be getting past this line, regardless of how powerful they were. Kent currently possessed over six hundred Shadow Fiends, the majority of them suppressed to the Demigod stage.
Inside the hall, Kent began taking measured yet relaxed steps toward the Fatty, who was now lying on the ground under overwhelming pressure.
Every step increased the pressure.
"You... what... are... what are you doing?" he asked, struggling to force the words out.
Kent looked at him coldly and replied in a tone that sounded more like a narration.
"Many warriors fought during the Flame War, and many died making sure the universe and everyone within it was protected. One of those brave warriors was the Nine Dragon Whip Goddess, Meiko.
Growing up, she was looked down upon by her peers and siblings, mainly because she had no affinity for any element and was born with low talent across all aspects of cultivation.
However, she never gave up on her dreams. She believed that with enough effort, she could accomplish them.
And she did.
Her dreams came true, and she went on to become one of the greatest warriors to walk the face of this universe.
Do you know that before she died, she made sure an entire galaxy of people was protected? The universe itself bestowed upon her a True Name and reincarnated her soul.
So, for you to dare question me about what I am doing... do you really expect me to answer that?"
Kent now stood a meter away from the Fatty, whose bones had already shattered and whose face had turned deathly pale.
"What... what do you mean?" he asked, still struggling to speak, let alone stand.
Hearing the question, Kent smiled and slowly shook his head.
"You dared to enslave a hero whose sacrifice helped save this universe. So, as your punishment, I am going to slowly and painfully roast you with the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
Be grateful, for this flame is only a spark of its true glory."
Black flames ignited in Kent’s palm.
Then he sent them toward the Fatty, engulfing him instantly.
"AAAARRRGGGHHHHH!"
His screams filled the hall, echoed throughout the ship, and even escaped into the space channel.

Kent pulled over a chair and sat down. Then, drawing upon his extensive mastery of flame control, he began manipulating the Umbral Flame of Oblivion to burn the areas he knew would produce the greatest agony.

After reuniting with Lady Wu and paying for everything he had won at the auction, Kent returned to the tower with the three ladies.
Lady Wu wanted to handle everything with her own money, but Kent refused since he wanted to fulfill a quest.
Aside from that, he informed Lady Khronisia from the Blacksmith association that she should give him 5 days.
She accepted, and Kent dispatched 10 shadow fiends to protect her while he was away.
When he returned, he discovered that Liora and her team had completed their mission and had even returned with over seven million Sand Demons.
Kent was a bit shaken when he saw the millions of Sand Demons now occupying Nagaraja, one of the cities unoccupied until they came.
Gaia and her team had built it for occasions when an impromptu migration is needed, and they can’t put something up in that short a time.
To congratulate his three wives on a job well done, Kent spent a month with them inside the harem tower.
His three wives had done well, so he made sure they felt appreciated.
While that was happening, Lady Wu was also getting acquainted with some of Kent’s wives and the various races inside the tower.
Every last being inside the tower sees Kent as their savior and his wives as their rulers, so they made sure she was introduced to everyone.
Kent saw that she needed time to adjust to her new life, so he didn’t move forward with officially making her his woman just yet.
That time would come eventually.

"You..." She blinked several times, perhaps to make sure her eyes weren’t deceiving her.
"Kent Madson?"
It turned out her eyes weren’t deceiving her at all, but she was still in disbelief.
Kent smiled and replied, "In the flesh."
His expression showed he wasn’t the least bit bothered by the spear pressed against his throat.
"Perhaps you should move the pointy thing away from my throat first."
The young lady quickly lowered her spear and apologized.
"I am sorry.

"Oh, he didn’t invite me.

The young lady was merely an Immortal King, so she was no match for Kent, who could fight gods.
"Relax, young lady.
I am here to kill your master.
If anything, you should be thrilled."

Even so, he could tell she genuinely wanted to kill him.
This made Kent sigh and frown slightly.
"So that is how things are, huh?"
It appeared that with the slave collar on, even if she wanted her master dead, the moment his life was threatened, she would be compelled to protect him.
Right now, all she wanted was to kill Kent and protect her master.
It wasn’t even a matter of resisting the collar anymore.
She simply wanted to kill Kent.

Kent’s hand moved, and the next second, she passed out.

Then his expression turned icy.

However, they all came to an abrupt halt when shadows materialized, forming a line of deadly Demigod-level Shadow Fiends.
None of them would be getting past this line, regardless of how powerful they were.
Kent currently possessed over six hundred Shadow Fiends, the majority of them suppressed to the Demigod stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1754: Agony of a Celestial
paragraphs: "AAAAARRRGGGHHHH!"

Somewhere in the Celestial Realm, a fat man about the size of a mansion let out a scream so loud that the planet he was on trembled vigrously. He was so fat that his very skin looked as though it was about to peel off.
Every inhabitant on the planet turned pale, their bodies coming to a halt at the sound of the man’s scream.
"BASTARD KENT MADSON!"
Across his skin, faint black flames crawled, slowly eating away at it and melting the fat. This man was once known as the Devouring God, but now he was a Celestial and one of the most powerful ones.

Back when he was still a god, he had chanced upon a fruit known as devil’s fruit during one of his explorations. This fruit possessed several unique properties, one of which was the ability to divide the body.

By eating it, one could split their body into four. He had done exactly that, sending one body to the Immortal Realm, another to the God Realm, the third to the Supreme Realm, and finally keeping the last in the Celestial Realm.
He was known as Lord Deckins in his Immortal body, but Nakpel in his Celestial body, which could be considered his main body.

Across all four bodies, he was extremely wealthy and loved to eat. After all, his unique Devourer Constitution allowed him to gain power primarily through eating. Having four bodies, all dedicated to consuming treasures and delicacies, was incredibly convenient.

However, today, just as he was served a table full of meals prepared from Celestial-grade ingredients, he sensed someone attacking his Immortal body. To his shock, the pain transferred to his other bodies.
Somewhere in the God Realm and the Supreme Realm, he released the same agonising scream and slowly began to experience the torture his Immortal body was enduring.
Even more heartbreaking, he could do nothing but endure the pain for hours.

After hours of agonising torture, his Immortal body finally died, causing a fragment of his soul to shatter. It would take a tremendous amount of time—and an even greater amount of eating—to repair the damage.
However, no matter what he did, he would never be able to create another Immortal body.
"Kent Madson..." he gritted through clenched teeth.
With a wave of his hand, he vanished, reappearing several million miles away from the planet he had been on.
His new destination was a cave suspended in the depths of the cosmos. Despite his enormous size, he walked forward with heavy, earth-shaking steps before entering the cave.
A few minutes later, he emerged, now holding an item that resembled the head of a tiger.
Once outside, he slashed his palm, drawing blood. Then he brought his dripping hand closer to the item and allowed his blood to drip onto it.
ROAR!
A thunderous roar erupted from the item.

The next moment, it transformed into a gigantic tiger that stood with an imposing presence. Its white-and-red fur rippled with overwhelming power, while each of its four legs was encased in metallic, gauntlet-like armour that ended in razor-sharp talons.
Its tail split into four whip-like appendages, each ending in the head of a venomous snake. Aside from that, it possessed metallic teeth and a pair of metallic horns.
"ROAR!"
It released another earth-shaking roar before lowering its massive head toward the mountain of fat, whose expression remained as ugly as ever. Celestial Lord Nakpel was furious, and he wanted blood.
"Go to the Immortal Realm and kill the one called Kent Madson. I don’t care what you have to do—make sure he dies, and that his body is shredded to pieces," he commanded.
The tiger nodded.
One of its clawed legs swung forward, tearing open the fabric of space and revealing a dark abyss. With a single leap, it disappeared into the void, and the rift closed behind it.
"Kent Madson, I will show you that in this universe, not everyone is someone you can afford to mess with."
He waved his hand once more and returned to the planet.

Kent, of course, had no idea that something like this had happened. However, even if he knew, he wouldn’t think much of it. After all, in his eyes, if humans couldn’t kill him, then spirit treasures wouldn’t be able to do anything to him either.
If only he knew...
Kent stared at the charred, melted corpse of Lord Deckins, who, after twenty-four hours of torture, couldn’t endure it any longer—or rather, Kent had finally allowed him to die.
Now, he had been reduced to a lump of charred flesh, and considering how unbelievably fat he had been, even his skin had melted under the heat of the flames.
"Serves you right. Next time, be sure to live a righteous life and never enslave people." He smirked before turning to look around the dining hall.
[Master, I don’t think this man was a complete person.] Tower suddenly spoke, making Kent frown slightly.
"What do you mean?"
[Usually, when you kill a person or beast, I receive their complete soul essence. However, this man only gave me a quarter of his soul. That can only mean one thing...]
"He was a partial body."

[Yes. However, I also sense something peculiar about his soul. While he is one part of a whole divided into four, his soul is the weakest, which means his other bodies may have already reached higher realms. It also means they are aware that you killed one of their bodies, and of course, they will come after you.]
Kent smiled faintly.
"Well, what’s done is done, so we can only hope the person whose body I just killed is the reasonable kind."
Tower transformed into her humanoid form and looked at Kent with a deadpan expression.
[Master, you just killed someone’s partial body, and you think they’re going to be reasonable about it?]
"I mean, if you look at it from my perspective, he had enslaved a great warrior who fought for the universe, so death was as merciful as I could be," he replied with a grin.
[Unbelievable.]
Kent simply laughed before turning to the most important part of the entire ordeal.
"Gather the items and his treasures so we can be on our way."
Kent waved his hand, and Kenna, one of his Soul Warriors who specialised in severing soul connections, appeared.
"Free the slaves."
She nodded and vanished from the hall.

[Uhm, Master, it appears we won’t be having any luck today. The man stored all of his treasures inside a secret dimension shared with his other bodies. The only way to obtain them is to kill his remaining bodies.]
"Of course, he would have something like that. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been buying treasures as though he had no better use for his money."
Kent smirked and walked out of the room.
Outside, he saw that his Shadow Fiends had already subdued the guards. Kenna was also busy removing the slave collars from everyone.

Seeing that everything was in order, Kent headed toward the building where Meiko was sleeping. When he arrived, he found that she was still unconscious. He sat beside her and quietly waited for her to wake up.
A couple of minutes later, Kenna entered the room. With a flick of her hand, the slave collar around Meiko’s neck fell to the ground.
"That was the last one, Master."
"Thank you, Kenna. You can go back now. If I need anything else, I’ll call for you."
She nodded before returning to the Soul Universe to continue her cultivation.
Three hours later, Meiko slowly opened her eyes.
"Rise and shine, Meiko," Kent said with a broad smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1755: Nine Dragon Whip Goddess
paragraphs: While Meiko was asleep, she had a dream in which she was a legendary warrior who specialised in wielding a divine whip that could transform into nine different dragon heads.

Although the dream began with her being looked down upon by her sisters and the people she had once considered friends, it soon took a different turn in her life. She became cheerful, fiercely competitive, and endlessly passionate about battle.
She challenged every warrior she deemed worthy, and perhaps to prove her worth to everyone, she defeated them with overwhelming ease.

During the dream, she met a blacksmith who became the first person to ever defeat her. From that day onward, she became infatuated with him to the point where she chased away anyone who dared approach him, especially women.
Then, just before she awoke from the dream, she saw herself fighting in one of history’s greatest wars, dying with a smile on her face.
Waking up would have been one of the saddest moments of her life, had it not been for Kent smiling back at her the moment she opened her eyes.
The first thought that crossed her mind was to attack Kent.
However, that impulse wasn’t nearly as intense as it usually was whenever her master’s life was threatened.
That realisation made her hand instinctively move to her neck, but she felt nothing...
For a brief moment, she froze.
’This feeling...’
She could feel it.
The compulsion she always experienced whenever she learned that someone intended to harm her master was gone. In fact, she now felt incredibly free.
Her mind had been cleared of all the anger-filled thoughts that had constantly plagued it, and as she looked at Kent now, she felt absolutely no compulsion to kill him.
"Told ya," Kent said with a grin as he walked toward the window, gazing outside at the dozens of people Kenna had freed after he killed Lord Deckins.
"I’ve already killed Lord Deckins and freed you from your shackles, so you’re a free woman now."
Meiko was stunned.
Naturally, she had never imagined that she would one day be freed from the shackles that had bound her neck for thousands of years. In her mind, she was destined to remain her master’s slave forever.
But things were different now, leaving her in utter disbelief.
"It is over now, Meiko. You are free. So the next thing you need to do is reclaim your life and continue walking the path you once tread."
Kent waved his hand, and a small jade token appeared in his palm.

"Contained within this token are the memories of a life you once lived. Along with them, your legacy as the Nine Dragon Whip Goddess has also been preserved. Absorb it, become who you have always been, and fulfil the destiny that has always belonged to you."
Kent released the token, and it floated toward Meiko. Still in a state of shock, she instinctively reached out and caught it.

Kent then commanded the ship to exit the space channel and hover somewhere within the endless expanse of space. Receiving a quest for everyone he had interacted with in his past lives almost seemed like the universe’s own doing.
First was Sahir, who returned to his peak in merely a few hours.
Now, it was Meiko’s turn, and Kent couldn’t wait to see her return to the pinnacle of her strength once more.
Just like him, she also had unfinished business with the Soul Temple.
"When you’re ready, just press the jade token against your forehead, and everything will proceed from there."

Kent spoke, and Meiko turned to look at him, yet she remained silent. Deep down, she had countless questions, but for reasons she couldn’t explain, everything about what was about to happen simply felt right.
Kent couldn’t help but wonder whether the other people he had interacted with in his previous lives would also have tragic fates like Sahir and Meiko.
The thought alone made him question whether the universe was acting intentionally or if it was simply the fate they had always been destined to endure.
Sahir had been an ordinary person before meeting Kevin Sage. Meiko had also been mediocre at best until she experienced her breakthrough, and Fjorge forged the Nine Dragon Whip for her.
’’Maybe it’s simply a repetition of their past lives. The only difference this time is that I’ll be the one to awaken them from their slumber.’’
With that thought, he quietly waited for Meiko.
A few minutes later, Meiko raised the jade token to her forehead and pressed it against her skin.
Almost instantly, a tremendous wave of energy erupted from her body.
Moments later, she was encased within a cocoon woven from countless elemental energies.

Meiko herself possessed no elemental affinity. Instead, what she had was an extraordinarily vast and powerful soul capable of manifesting into physical constructs. The more she harnessed the power of her soul, the greater her control over the laws of the universe became.
Her very presence alone influenced the laws.
Thus, when Fjorge forged the Nine Dragon Whip for her and she inherited the countless elemental powers it contained, she became an unstoppable force.
Now, the cocoon surrounding her contained flames, ice, water, lightning, wind, earth, and every other elemental law.
Kent remained seated, keeping a close watch on what would happen next.
Ten hours later, the entire ship began to tremble violently.
Kent immediately commanded Tower to send everyone aboard into the Tower Garden.
The very next second—
BOOOM
The ship exploded.
Kent was blasted several miles away, cursing as his body shot through the vacuum of space. He had completely forgotten what had happened with Sahir.
Fortunately, there were no asteroids nearby this time. After hurtling through space for several thousand kilometres, he summoned the Jade Void Wings and finally managed to stabilise himself.
WHOOSH
The Nine Dragon Whip flew out from the Tower’s storage before vanishing into the distance.
Having learned his lesson, Kent made no attempt to approach the destruction in the distance.
However...
The carnage came to him instead.
The moment the Nine Dragon Whip disappeared, a violent gust of wind erupted before him, followed by an ocean of flames, ice, water, lightning, and countless other elemental forces.
Standing at the centre of that elemental maelstrom was a Meiko with a broad, athletic frame, a bountiful chest, and a fierce, battle-hardened aura.

She stood 6’2" tall, with jade-like crimson eyes and crimson hair braided behind her head, giving her the unmistakable appearance of a seasoned warrior. In her hand is the Nine Dragon Whip, now humming with energy.
It had finally reunited with its true master after billions of years.
The reason Fjorge had fallen in love with this crazy woman was that the two of them shared the same temperament.
Fjorge becomes extremely chaotic whenever he is angry.
Meiko, on the other hand...
She was chaotic every single day.
Not a single day passed without her picking a fight.
In fact, she alone had singlehandedly killed more Soul Temple agents than anyone else in history.
While others fled from danger, Meiko charged straight toward it...
Or better yet, went looking for it.
So the moment she appeared before Kent, the dragon knew his life was about to become exceedingly painful.
"Don’t die."
She said, then she attacked.

Kent didn’t even have time to summon a weapon. He instinctively met the descending whip with his bare fist, channelling as much strength as he could summon in that moment. It was instantaneous, and she came fully prepared for him.
BOOM!!
His body was blasted away, shooting through space like a falling star.
Yet before he could even process how fast he was travelling, a massive crimson dragon head materialised directly in front of him.
"Oh, come—"
He hadn’t even finished summoning the Chaos Scale Shield before the enormous dragon head slammed into him.
BOOOM
Kent was blasted away once again, blood spraying from his mouth as he tumbled uncontrollably through space.
’This bitch...

Then, just before she awoke from the dream, she saw herself fighting in one of history’s greatest wars, dying with a smile on her face.
Waking up would have been one of the saddest moments of her life, had it not been for Kent smiling back at her the moment she opened her eyes.
The first thought that crossed her mind was to attack Kent.
However, that impulse wasn’t nearly as intense as it usually was whenever her master’s life was threatened.
That realisation made her hand instinctively move to her neck, but she felt nothing...
For a brief moment, she froze.
’This feeling...’
She could feel it.
The compulsion she always experienced whenever she learned that someone intended to harm her master was gone.
In fact, she now felt incredibly free.
Her mind had been cleared of all the anger-filled thoughts that had constantly plagued it, and as she looked at Kent now, she felt absolutely no compulsion to kill him.
"Told ya," Kent said with a grin as he walked toward the window, gazing outside at the dozens of people Kenna had freed after he killed Lord Deckins.
"I’ve already killed Lord Deckins and freed you from your shackles, so you’re a free woman now."
Meiko was stunned.
Naturally, she had never imagined that she would one day be freed from the shackles that had bound her neck for thousands of years.
In her mind, she was destined to remain her master’s slave forever.
But things were different now, leaving her in utter disbelief.
"It is over now, Meiko.
You are free.
So the next thing you need to do is reclaim your life and continue walking the path you once tread."
Kent waved his hand, and a small jade token appeared in his palm.
"Contained within this token are the memories of a life you once lived.
Along with them, your legacy as the Nine Dragon Whip Goddess has also been preserved.
Absorb it, become who you have always been, and fulfil the destiny that has always belonged to you."
Kent released the token, and it floated toward Meiko.
Still in a state of shock, she instinctively reached out and caught it.
Kent then commanded the ship to exit the space channel and hover somewhere within the endless expanse of space.
Receiving a quest for everyone he had interacted with in his past lives almost seemed like the universe’s own doing.
First was Sahir, who returned to his peak in merely a few hours.
Now, it was Meiko’s turn, and Kent couldn’t wait to see her return to the pinnacle of her strength once more.
Just like him, she also had unfinished business with the Soul Temple.
"When you’re ready, just press the jade token against your forehead, and everything will proceed from there."
Kent spoke, and Meiko turned to look at him, yet she remained silent.
Deep down, she had countless questions, but for reasons she couldn’t explain, everything about what was about to happen simply felt right.
Kent couldn’t help but wonder whether the other people he had interacted with in his previous lives would also have tragic fates like Sahir and Meiko.
The thought alone made him question whether the universe was acting intentionally or if it was simply the fate they had always been destined to endure.
Sahir had been an ordinary person before meeting Kevin Sage.
Meiko had also been mediocre at best until she experienced her breakthrough, and Fjorge forged the Nine Dragon Whip for her.
’’Maybe it’s simply a repetition of their past lives.
The only difference this time is that I’ll be the one to awaken them from their slumber.’’
With that thought, he quietly waited for Meiko.
A few minutes later, Meiko raised the jade token to her forehead and pressed it against her skin.
Almost instantly, a tremendous wave of energy erupted from her body.
Moments later, she was encased within a cocoon woven from countless elemental energies.
Meiko herself possessed no elemental affinity.
Instead, what she had was an extraordinarily vast and powerful soul capable of manifesting into physical constructs.
The more she harnessed the power of her soul, the greater her control over the laws of the universe became.
Her very presence alone influenced the laws.
Thus, when Fjorge forged the Nine Dragon Whip for her and she inherited the countless elemental powers it contained, she became an unstoppable force.
Now, the cocoon surrounding her contained flames, ice, water, lightning, wind, earth, and every other elemental law.
Kent remained seated, keeping a close watch on what would happen next.
Ten hours later, the entire ship began to tremble violently.
Kent immediately commanded Tower to send everyone aboard into the Tower Garden.
The very next second—
BOOOM
The ship exploded.
Kent was blasted several miles away, cursing as his body shot through the vacuum of space.
He had completely forgotten what had happened with Sahir.
Fortunately, there were no asteroids nearby this time.
After hurtling through space for several thousand kilometres, he summoned the Jade Void Wings and finally managed to stabilise himself.
WHOOSH
The Nine Dragon Whip flew out from the Tower’s storage before vanishing into the distance.
Having learned his lesson, Kent made no attempt to approach the destruction in the distance.
However...
The carnage came to him instead.
The moment the Nine Dragon Whip disappeared, a violent gust of wind erupted before him, followed by an ocean of flames, ice, water, lightning, and countless other elemental forces.
Standing at the centre of that elemental maelstrom was a Meiko with a broad, athletic frame, a bountiful chest, and a fierce, battle-hardened aura.
She stood 6’2" tall, with jade-like crimson eyes and crimson hair braided behind her head, giving her the unmistakable appearance of a seasoned warrior.
In her hand is the Nine Dragon Whip, now humming with energy.
It had finally reunited with its true master after billions of years.
The reason Fjorge had fallen in love with this crazy woman was that the two of them shared the same temperament.
Fjorge becomes extremely chaotic whenever he is angry.
Meiko, on the other hand...
She was chaotic every single day.
Not a single day passed without her picking a fight.
In fact, she alone had singlehandedly killed more Soul Temple agents than anyone else in history.
While others fled from danger, Meiko charged straight toward it...
Or better yet, went looking for it.
So the moment she appeared before Kent, the dragon knew his life was about to become exceedingly painful.
"Don’t die."
She said, then she attacked.
Kent didn’t even have time to summon a weapon.
He instinctively met the descending whip with his bare fist, channelling as much strength as he could summon in that moment.
It was instantaneous, and she came fully prepared for him.
BOOM!!
His body was blasted away, shooting through space like a falling star.
Yet before he could even process how fast he was travelling, a massive crimson dragon head materialised directly in front of him.
"Oh, come—"
He hadn’t even finished summoning the Chaos Scale Shield before the enormous dragon head slammed into him.
BOOOM
Kent was blasted away once again, blood spraying from his mouth as he tumbled uncontrollably through space.
’This bitch...

chapters.title: Chapter 1756: Deadly Collision
paragraphs: BOOOM!

Kent was sent flying back yet again. However, he managed to stabilise himself mid-flight and summon Gaap. Then, tapping into his Chaos Heart, he channels streams of chaotic energy, filling the entire space around him with deadly intent.

He chose to hold back his Ice Essence, Darkness Essence, Flame Cores, Evil Cores, Blood Cores, and even his Lightning Essence. This battle was far from over, and he knew it was best to keep his options open.
Kent already knew that he would never win this battle, regardless of what trump cards he brought out.
He was merely an Immortal Monarch who had yet to become a Demigod, a God, or a Supreme before finally reaching the realm of Celestials.
Meiko, however, was already a Celestial Supreme, someone who stood at the peak of power in this universe.
Aside from that, her abilities were simply too strange for Kent to counter. So, basically, he was going into the battle with a losing mindset.
However, it was also a friendly yet deadly bout, so he had to bring his A-game, or else he would lose miserably. To make sure he doesn’t lose, he chooses to go into the battle as a swordsman.
His eyes changed from purple to red, and the Jade Void Wings spread open, humming with Void Essence.
He had just taken the full-on attacks of a Celestial, yet all he did was cough up blood. Naturally, that was impressive, but Kent knew he had to do more than this.
So he summoned his dragon tail, which, in his human form, looked like a whip. Then, without any hesitation, he unleashed the movement technique that came with the [Jade Void Wings].
"Void Glide."
The move was executed, and the next second, he collided with Meiko, creating a deadly shockwave and explosion that spread far and wide, pushing space debris aside.
Kent was also knocked back, but he immediately surged forward and unleashed a deadly sword arc.
"Void Cleave."

A deadly arc flashed out from his sword and exploded toward Meiko, who stood exactly where she had been when she met Kent’s slash. This time around, too, she remained calm and merely swung her whip, destroying the sword arc.
However, Kent was already upon her.
"Cleaving the Heavens."
His Sword Intent exploded, and thousands of swords materialised into a single colossal blade, shaking space itself. Then, with one deadly slash, the sword descended, shattering the space around it.
Kent vanished, and the next second, a massive asteroid appeared in the air and hurtled toward Meiko, burning with crimson flames.
"Interesting... You have some techniques, Fjorge," Meiko smiled and extended her left hand, firing a beam at the sword.
BOOOM!
The colossal sword shattered, and shockwaves spread everywhere.
Then, with a swing of her whip, it transformed into a white dragon’s head and extended into an impossibly long whip. This white dragon head carried the power of the metal element.
The asteroid, which was powerful enough to squash most bugs, was blasted to pieces as though it were nothing more than limestone.
That showed the true power of a Celestial who wasn’t even trying.
However, Kent wasn’t simple either.
WHOOSH!
The moment the asteroid was blasted to pieces, a wave of soul attack slammed into Meiko’s soul, causing her brow to furrow.
"Soul Annihilation Slash."
Kent appeared above her like a blur, and before Meiko could process where Kent had gotten that much Soul Essence to form the asteroid, a massive sword arc descended upon her.
This time, she extended her hand, and her Soul Essence transformed into a transparent shield.
BOOOM!

The attack slammed into it, and a shockwave erupted outward, sending Kent flying back. But he wasn’t gone for long. The moment his body was flung away, he tapped into the Darkness Element he had yet to awaken.
Under normal circumstances, he shouldn’t have been able to harness it. However, thanks to the Faceless Assassin, he could already wield a fraction of its power.
His intelligence, inherited from Kevin Sage, kicked in, and for a brief moment, he saw the one opening that would force Meiko onto the defensive.
He took it by vanishing into the shadows.
"Huh?"
Meiko frowned slightly, but she was forced to retreat when a chilling killing intent washed over her. The next instant, a sword appeared before her face.
"Hey, watch where you’re attacking," she pouted as she leaned back to evade it.
However, Kent didn’t let her create any distance. His tail lashed out, and the scales along it rearranged themselves, transforming into a deadly, flexible spear.
Meiko shifted to her left, effortlessly evading the piercing strike, only to step straight into the trap Kent had prepared.
A few seconds earlier, the moment he found the opening, he had activated two Divine Sword Bodies. One attacked Meiko’s neck, while the other wielded the dragon tail as its weapon to attack.
Meanwhile, the main body had perfectly calculated how she would evade where she would step.
So he waited.
The instant she stepped into that spot, Kent materialised from the shadows like a phantom and pressed a dagger toward Meiko’s neck.
Or at least, he tried to.
The moment the dagger came within inches of Meiko’s neck, Kent felt an overwhelming force slam into his back, sending him hurtling through the sky like a comet.
Unfortunately for him, this time he slammed into a passing asteroid, sending a wave of pain surging through his body. However, thanks to the Jade Void Wings, he forced himself to come to a halt.

The three pairs of black-and-red wings were playing their role perfectly. However, despite their aid in stabilising his body, Kent knew there was no way he could escape any further attacks if this were a real battle.
’I am still too weak against Celestials.’
He smiled and wiped the blood from the corner of his lips before narrowing his eyes at Meiko, who stood calmly in the air, gazing back at him with a smile on her face.
"You are enjoying this, aren’t you?" Kent asked.
She spread her arms and nodded.

"More than I ever dreamed. I always wanted to beat you, Fjorge. It was just that no matter how hard I tried back then, I never could." A grin spread across her face before she added, "Now, however, I can beat the hell out of you before you regain your true strength."
Kent stared at her for a long moment before a smile slowly formed on his face.
"You know, I never expected to fight a Celestial this early in my journey. However, since I know nothing I do can kill you, allow me to test just how strong I have become as a swordsman."
Kent tightened his grip on his sword.
Then, a terrifying wave of Sword Intent and Sword Aura erupted from his body, forming a vast sea of swords. Kent decided to unleash his Genesis Sword Realm.
The sea surged so violently that, for a moment, it was as though a Celestial swordsman had descended upon the battlefield.
"This is..."
Meiko furrowed her brow, clearly unable to believe that what she was seeing was merely a Sword Realm. It hadn’t even reached the level of a Sword Domain, yet it made her become stunned.
"Taste my Genesis Sword Realm Meiko."

Kent slashed his sword forward, and the sea of swords surged like a colossal tide, rushing toward Meiko at such terrifying speed that she barely had time to snap out of her stunned expression before she was completely engulfed.
To the ordinary eye, it looked like nothing more than a surging ocean.
However, to the trained eye, that "water" was actually billions of swords packed so densely together that they appeared to flow like a single, unstoppable sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 1757: Going All Out
paragraphs: Meiko stood amid the sea of swords, her expression calm, but deep within, she couldn’t wrap her mind around the fact that the surrounding sea was someone’s Sword Realm.
’This is enough to kill even a True God,’ she thought inwardly, stunned.
Of course, she had no idea that Kent had already attained the Absolute Form of Divine Sword Energy—both Sword Intent and Sword Aura.
Kent’s Sword Energy had been so refined to the point that it would make it incredibly difficult for even someone who possessed Immortal Sword Energy to defend against him.

Considering he could be regarded as the greatest swordsman to have ever lived, his understanding of the sword, coupled with the vast knowledge he now possessed of countless other weapons, had elevated the power of his Sword Realm to an astonishing level.
Even so, it was still far from being capable of injuring someone like Meiko.
She erected a shield around herself, and despite the relentless barrage crashing against it, the barrier refused to break. Naturally, against Celestial Qi, Kent’s Sword Energy was far weaker.
Even so, the shockwaves produced by every collision were already enough to reveal the calibre of warrior Kent truly was.
But the dragon whose sword realm is proving ineffective knew he wasn’t done yet.

Perhaps realising that his Sword Realm alone was ineffective against her, Kent tapped into his Ice Element and unleashed a deadly wave of frost that flooded into the Sword Realm, beginning to transform it.
At first, it was merely a sea of swords.
However, once the ice was infused into it, the entire realm took on an icy aura. Meiko, who stood amid the storm of blades, immediately felt the Genesis Sword Realm’s danger increase severalfold.
’This is unbelievable,’ she thought inwardly, unsure what to say or even what she could do differently.

Although she wasn’t in any danger, the mere fact that Kent had successfully infused ice into his Sword Realm told her exactly what kind of swordsman he was and why underestimating him would be a grave mistake.
"Still not enough," Kent muttered.
Then he tapped into his Flame Cores, igniting the Genesis Sword Realm with two different flames.

The first was green flame, instantly flooding the Sword Realm with overwhelming heat. Despite retaining its freezing aura, the realm was now also engulfed in blazing flames, making the Genesis Sword Realm appear even more chaotic.
Soon afterwards, another section of the realm turned crimson as the second Flame Core awakened.
Kent smiled before channelling the Lightning Essence he could currently command, fusing all three elements into the Genesis Sword Realm.

By the time he finished, if the Genesis Sword Realm alone had been capable of killing a True God, then after being augmented by the three elements, it had become so deadly that even God Kings and God Emperors might perish within it.
Kent was no longer holding back.
He had gone all out, and the results were obvious.
His Genesis Sword Realm, now empowered by three elements, had become something else entirely.

"You are not as simple as I expected, Fjorge," Meiko said, unleashing a devastating swing of the Nine Dragon Whip that instantly blasted the Genesis Sword Realm apart, revealing her flawless figure once more.
"If this is all you can do, then I’m sorry, but you would lose miserably against me."
Kent smiled and narrowed his eyes.
The next second, an even more concentrated and refined form of his Divine Sword Energy flooded the battlefield.
The instant Meiko sensed it, she reinforced the shield surrounding her.
It was as though instinct itself warned her that her current barrier would not withstand the power Kent was about to unleash.
With every passing moment, the terrifying aura surrounding Kent intensified.
It was as though an ancient Sword Energy, one that had never before existed in this universe, was slowly awakening within him.
’What is he up to now?’ Meiko wondered inwardly, a small part of her beginning to question whether allowing Kent to attack freely had been the right decision.
Just moments ago, Kent possessed enough power to kill a God King with ease.
Now, the aura radiating from him was increasing his level of danger several times beyond even that.
Meanwhile, Kent stood silently, staring at the messages before his eyes.
[You have fused 2% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
[You have fused 4% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
[You have fused 6% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
[You have fused 10% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
The notifications stopped there, indicating that he had reached his limit.
However, by then, the energy surrounding him had become so concentrated that even Meiko could sense the deadly power hidden within it.
The next moment, the Genesis Sword Realm began to transform.
The sea of swords started merging together, forming much larger blades.

In the blink of an eye, the sky was filled with two-meter-long swords, each gleaming with a refined metallic lustre. Around them, waves of Sword Energy permeated the air, causing Meiko’s brows to furrow even further.
"You know what? I feel like trashing you today was worth it." She smiled. "I have a feeling that the moment your Sword Realm evolves into a Sword Domain, even I would fail to defend against you."
A faint smile appeared on Kent’s face.
"I can hurt you now if I want to. However, why don’t you test the integrity and danger level of my Genesis Sword Realm?"
Kent slashed his sword downward.
The countless swords moved as one.
’This madman...’
Meiko quickly formed a hand seal, and the shield around her became even sturdier.
However, unlike before, when she had stood there completely unconcerned, this time she watched with genuine intrigue as the shield formed from Celestial Qi was gradually being chipped away.
Kent had already imbued Ice, Fire, and Lightning into his Sword Realm.

However, when he realised that still wasn’t enough, he fused ten percent of his Blood Qi with his Absolute Divine Sword Energy, using it to transform the Genesis Sword Realm into something even more terrifying.
At its current level, he could easily kill a Universal God, provided he was given the opportunity to unleash the full might of the Genesis Sword Realm.
This was the peak of power Kent could currently harness as a swordsman.
His body simply wasn’t strong enough to withstand infusing Chaos Qi and Evil Qi into the attack as well.
So, for now, if he were to go all out as a swordsman, this was his absolute limit.
He had unleashed everything he could.
Meanwhile, Meiko, standing at the very centre of the terrifying Sword Realm, was left too shocked to speak.
Twenty minutes later, she sighed and extended a hand, condensing a small sphere of Soul Essence.

"You know, growing up, I fought countless swordsmen—many with extraordinary talents and incredible mastery over their Sword Realms and Sword Domains." She smiled as she looked at Kent. "But after witnessing what you’re capable of today, I have only one thing to say, Fjorge."
She clenched the sphere of Soul Essence.
A wave of exquisitely refined Soul Power exploded outward, instantly erasing every sword in the sky.
"You are a monster among monsters."
Kent wasn’t surprised that someone else had forcefully dispersed his Sword Realm.
He knew exactly where his current limits lay.
Now that he had tested the full extent of his abilities as a swordsman, he also understood what he needed to do next to ensure the next time he went all out, he could injure even a Celestial.

’I need to finish things here quickly and head to the Flame Paradise. I have to find the Nirvana Flame there and begin cultivating the Fourteen-Fold Nirvana Body Tempering Art immediately. My body is still far too weak.’

The instant Meiko sensed it, she reinforced the shield surrounding her.
It was as though instinct itself warned her that her current barrier would not withstand the power Kent was about to unleash.
With every passing moment, the terrifying aura surrounding Kent intensified.
It was as though an ancient Sword Energy, one that had never before existed in this universe, was slowly awakening within him.
’What is he up to now?’ Meiko wondered inwardly, a small part of her beginning to question whether allowing Kent to attack freely had been the right decision.
Just moments ago, Kent possessed enough power to kill a God King with ease.
Now, the aura radiating from him was increasing his level of danger several times beyond even that.
Meanwhile, Kent stood silently, staring at the messages before his eyes.
[You have fused 2% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
[You have fused 4% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
[You have fused 6% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
[You have fused 10% Blood Qi into your Absolute Divine Sword Energy.]
The notifications stopped there, indicating that he had reached his limit.
However, by then, the energy surrounding him had become so concentrated that even Meiko could sense the deadly power hidden within it.
The next moment, the Genesis Sword Realm began to transform.
The sea of swords started merging together, forming much larger blades.
In the blink of an eye, the sky was filled with two-meter-long swords, each gleaming with a refined metallic lustre.
Around them, waves of Sword Energy permeated the air, causing Meiko’s brows to furrow even further.
"You know what?
I feel like trashing you today was worth it." She smiled.
"I have a feeling that the moment your Sword Realm evolves into a Sword Domain, even I would fail to defend against you."
A faint smile appeared on Kent’s face.
"I can hurt you now if I want to.
However, why don’t you test the integrity and danger level of my Genesis Sword Realm?"
Kent slashed his sword downward.
The countless swords moved as one.
’This madman...’
Meiko quickly formed a hand seal, and the shield around her became even sturdier.
However, unlike before, when she had stood there completely unconcerned, this time she watched with genuine intrigue as the shield formed from Celestial Qi was gradually being chipped away.
Kent had already imbued Ice, Fire, and Lightning into his Sword Realm.

However, when he realised that still wasn’t enough, he fused ten percent of his Blood Qi with his Absolute Divine Sword Energy, using it to transform the Genesis Sword Realm into something even more terrifying.
At its current level, he could easily kill a Universal God, provided he was given the opportunity to unleash the full might of the Genesis Sword Realm.
This was the peak of power Kent could currently harness as a swordsman.
His body simply wasn’t strong enough to withstand infusing Chaos Qi and Evil Qi into the attack as well.
So, for now, if he were to go all out as a swordsman, this was his absolute limit.
He had unleashed everything he could.
Meanwhile, Meiko, standing at the very centre of the terrifying Sword Realm, was left too shocked to speak.
Twenty minutes later, she sighed and extended a hand, condensing a small sphere of Soul Essence.
"You know, growing up, I fought countless swordsmen—many with extraordinary talents and incredible mastery over their Sword Realms and Sword Domains." She smiled as she looked at Kent.
"But after witnessing what you’re capable of today, I have only one thing to say, Fjorge."
She clenched the sphere of Soul Essence.
A wave of exquisitely refined Soul Power exploded outward, instantly erasing every sword in the sky.
"You are a monster among monsters."
Kent wasn’t surprised that someone else had forcefully dispersed his Sword Realm.
He knew exactly where his current limits lay.
Now that he had tested the full extent of his abilities as a swordsman, he also understood what he needed to do next to ensure the next time he went all out, he could injure even a Celestial.
’I need to finish things here quickly and head to the Flame Paradise.
I have to find the Nirvana Flame there and begin cultivating the Fourteen-Fold Nirvana Body Tempering Art immediately.
My body is still far too weak.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1758: Meiko’s Mission
paragraphs: With the Genesis Sword Realm vanquished, Kent knew he had to turn to his other options. However, before he could, Meiko spoke.
"It doesn’t matter what you throw at me, Fjorge. Winning at this stage is impossible."
"I know that, but I still have some trump cards," Kent responded, finally getting into the chaos of it all.
However, Meiko merely smirked. "Then become a Demigod or a God fast so we can have a proper duel. Right now, you are too weak to even force me to use 10% of my true strength."
Kent gave her a hard look before sighing. "Fine, but be prepared for our next battle because I won’t be the same anymore."
"I am counting on it." She smiled, then dove straight into Kent’s arms and kissed him.

"It’s been a minute, Fjorge. Or do you prefer I call you Kent instead?" Meiko asked, melting into Kent’s arms. Externally, she was as chaotic as they came. However, whenever she found somewhere she felt safe, she didn’t care how vulnerable she became.
"Just Kent will do. But feel free to call me Fjorge whenever we’re alone."

She smiled and rested her head against Kent’s chest. Then, placing her hand on his back, she started channeling her energy into his body, healing the internal injuries he had suffered during their battle.
After a few minutes, she pulled her hand back and stepped away.

She gave Kent a long, hard look before asking, "So how is any of this possible? One moment, I ignited my soul and channeled all my energy into my whip to kill a Primordial. The next, I woke up inside a cocoon, and despite having a different face, I instantly recognized you."
"How am I here, Kent? And how am I still a Celestial? In fact, I feel like I am way past the Celestial stage now."
Kent smiled and lifted her chin so she could stare directly into his eyes.

"It is a long story, but the short version is this: a very long time ago, another version of me invoked a spell that, over the course of many eras, picked some of the people who aided me in protecting every Era and reincarnated them.

That same version of me also won a bet against a Cosmic being. So, with their assistance, even though you died, they preserved your soul and cultivation. Now, I have merely returned what had always been yours."
Meiko stared at Kent for a long time, but no words came out of her mouth. First of all, she was stunned by everything she had just heard.

It was true that she had once stood at the peak of the universe and dominated countless battlefields. However, all of that, in her view, paled in comparison to hearing that someone—more accurately, another version of Kent—had invoked a spell that affected not just one era but several eras simultaneously.

Second, she had never once imagined that Fjorge had a past this extraordinary. The person she knew had always been hardworking, constantly chasing one opportunity after another. Everything he ever owned was earned through hard work.
Lastly, she never knew she had meant this much to Kent.

Kent may have said it casually, but to her, it sounded as though the spell only affected people who meant a great deal to him, like Sahir, who, despite the danger, made everything possible for Kevin Sage to succeed.
She had also faced a Primordial and willingly given her life without complaint, making sure the innocent were protected.
That alone was enough for her to know that Fjorge held her in high regard, and so the Spell of Origin had affected her as well.
Kent could tell Meiko had become emotional just from the way she looked at him. Seeing this, he smiled and added,
"Of course, by bringing you back, there is a price you have to pay. I have lived many lives, and each time, we faced different dangers.

However, aside from the Shadow Era, we could never completely eradicate all the threats. So now that you are back, we will have to deal with all of them. It is the price you have to pay for cheating reincarnation."
Meiko smiled and replied, "It is only natural. After all, I have a lot of unfinished business, one of them being the Flame Race."
Kent merely smirked and decided not to entertain that topic further. Otherwise, she would pressure him into finding the nearest battlefield where she could stretch her legs.
But she asked anyway. "Are we the ones invading this time, or do we have to wait for them to come?"
"Some will come, and we will have to visit some. In fact, I have already visited the Star Beast Race, and my subordinates are actively working to subjugate them."
"Can I join them?" Meiko asked, her eyes sparkling with excitement.
"No."
"Why?" she pouted, feeling wronged that Kent didn’t want her to join what she knew would be a deadly campaign filled with danger and mayhem.
"Inasmuch as I would love to have you join my subordinates, I have a very important mission for you."
"Even better." Her mood was instantly restored. "Where are you sending me?"
"The Underworld."
"Oh." Meiko narrowed her eyes slightly. "The last time we were there, you retrieved the Eighth and Ninth Underworld Sacred Flames. What were their names again?"
"Aeth’Xyron and Mor’Kaelith."
"Yes. I hope you are not sending me there to claim them again."
Kent smiled and replied, "Well, as a matter of fact, you are going there to claim all nine of them."
"Unbelievable."

Kent laughed and gave her a gentle pinch on the cheek. "The last time we were there, you had fun, and your Nine Dragon Whip also enjoyed the flame essence there. So take it as a trip filled with enjoyment and relaxation."
"Fine, but you will upgrade my weapon when I return. I can tell my weapon spirits have become more powerful, but the weapon itself is still weak."
"I will. In fact, I’ve already promised them. So get me the Nine Flames, and I will work on upgrading it. This time, I will make them extraordinarily powerful."
"Very well. When do I leave?"
"Right after you meet some of my wives. In fact, one of them is the Empress of the Underworld."
Sometime later, Meiko stood stunned in the Mountain Garden, looking at Pandora and some of Kent’s wives who hadn’t gone on any of the missions.
From Pandora down to Elina, the weakest among them, she could tell that the five women were anything but ordinary.

When Kent told her she would be meeting some of his wives, she had tried to act yandere. However, Kent had simply told her that once she met them, she would understand why she couldn’t dare behave the way she did back in the day.
Now, staring at the ladies before her, she knew she had to be careful, especially around Pandora and Yukiko, who were Primordial and Pseudo-Primordial, respectively.
"Nice to meet you, Meiko. Kent has told us a lot about you," Vexthra said, taking her hand.
During the auction, when Kent bought the Nine Dragon Whip, they had pressured him to tell them more about the person he intended to give it to.
So indeed, they had heard a lot about her, and now that they were finally meeting her, they could understand why Kent’s past incarnation had fallen in love with her.
