chapters.title: Chapter 1777: Hope
paragraphs: "I never knew a day would come when Zdzislav would praise a man," Veylan Seren said in a teasing tone, causing Zdzislav, known for singing praises to women as a form of flirting, to roll his eyes.
Initially, one would think Borislav was the rowdy one. However, Veylan Seren was actually the one with a more easy-going attitude.
Borislav just loves teasing everyone, regardless of their strength or the seriousness of the situation.
But what Veylan Seren said was indeed true. Zdzislav is known for perfection and not easily impressed.
The Astral Eye Chaos Tribe specializes in cultivating the Heavenly Chaos Eye Canon. It is one of the deadliest cultivation arts in the Chaos Chasm.
They cultivate their eyes to see the unseen and perceive things that most people would find extremely hard, if not impossible, to see, such as the Laws of Chaos and others.
Aside from that, they can also harness Chaos into beams and all kinds of abilities that, from what many had seen and witnessed over the last billions of years, make them one of the most feared races.
The ability to see before reacting or to predict an outcome merely from looking at a person makes them unpredictable and, in most cases, extremely dangerous to underestimate.
Kent had, at one point, cultivated the Omniscience Dao Eye, which had evolved through many stages into what it was before he entered the cycle of reincarnation.

At the moment, he had reached the Omniscient Jade Eye. However, with the technique he was about to receive and his extensive knowledge of cultivating his eyes, there was no telling what kind of monster he would soon become.
"There is hope for eye cultivators after all," Zdzislav said before transmitting the technique to Kent.
"Remember, according to the records left behind by past experts, the Heavenly Chaos Eye Canon has the ability to unlock the 7th dimension, where Existence was said to have originated from.

Nobody had ever reached that stage. In fact, the furthest anyone had ever reached was the 5th dimension, so I can’t say much. However, I believe and trust that one day, you can make it that far. When that day comes, and I still live, I would love to experience it, even if just for a moment."
Kent nodded. "I will do my best not to disappoint your expectations of me, Tribe Leader."
"I know you won’t because I trust you."
After he returned to his seat, Namarie, the leader of the Eternal Root Chaos Tribe, stood up and immediately started to speak...
"My Eternal Root Chaos Tribe is known for possessing healing abilities beyond measure. That is true by several degrees.
We are indeed a tribe of healers. However, we also possess a lethal side, though we lean more toward healing since, in my opinion, that’s better for everyone.
The World Root Chaos Scripture I am about to transfer to you has two parts. We have the Life Part, which concerns healing, and the Death Part, which concerns killing.
You can learn both, but I would advise you to go for the healing first. In my opinion, you need your life intact before you can think about killing someone else."
Kent nodded, then opened his soul and mind to receive the technique.
Afterward, Tumenk of the Celestial Abyss Chaos Tribe smiled, approached Kent, and placed his hand on his shoulder before speaking...
"There are nine stages to every Chaos Heart, and the Primordial Abyss Chaos Heart Art is meant to cultivate all nine stages."
Kent furrowed his brow, intrigued.

"Your current Chaos Heart hasn’t even stepped into the first stage. The moment it does, the current power of your Chaos Heart will multiply by ten. The second stage will multiply it by a hundred, and the third by a thousand."
"That sounds too good to be true," Kent said with a laugh, but Tumenk just smiled and said...

"It does sound too good to be true. However, it is the source of my power, so I wouldn’t lie. You will first cultivate the Abyss and merge it with Chaos, awakening Abyssal Chaos Energy, the pinnacle of Chaos Energy cultivation.
Once that is achieved, you will have to channel Abyssal Energy and Chaos Energy to refine your Chaos Heart until you achieve all nine stages."
"Which stage have you reached currently?" Kent asked.
"The 4th stage, still nowhere near the 5th stage. But even if I get stuck here, I have enough energy to keep me going until I reach the Universe Stage."
"Wow, that sounds incredible."

Tumenk smiled and answered, "That it does. However, it would take time to cultivate even a single stage, so for now, I will transfer it to you and provide more than enough treasures to aid you in reaching at least the first stage."
A few minutes later, he walked back to his seat, and the last tribe leader stood up.
Parand narrowed her eyes at Kent for a few seconds before she spoke, "I can sense a familiar wing treasure on you, kid. Do you happen to have a pair of Chaos Storm Wings?"

She summoned her four pairs of metallic wings, causing Kent to raise his brow. Then he also summoned the Jade Void Wings. The moment the wings appeared, Parand’s eyes widened, and she quickly moved toward them.
She touched both pairs as if to see if they were the ones she remembered.
As expected, they were the ones mentioned in the records.
"I believe these are called Jade Void Wings," she asked, and Kent nodded.
Her eyes sparkled upon getting the confirmation. This made Kent and everyone else wonder why she was crying.
Naturally, she gave them the answer a few minutes later.

"My tribe cultivates the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings, perhaps the deadliest flight-type technique in the world if your comprehension is deep enough. However, to cultivate the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings, you need to first awaken a wing."

She gestured toward her wings and continued, "Mine are the Flame Chaos Wings, meant to harness both the flame and chaos. Depending on which wings you awaken, you will have a dedicated cultivation method for them.

Over the years, rumors have circulated that when the Chaos Ascension King bestowed the technique on the first ancestor, he mentioned a wing that harnesses the power of the Void. This wing, if awakened, is destined to become the first ever to reach nine pairs and be unparalleled by all.

We have tried for years to awaken it, but have failed every time. Never in my wildest dreams did I expect it to appear here today, and with someone who doesn’t even have the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings cultivation art."
She looked Kent in the eye and asked, "How did you awaken the wings?"

"I didn’t awaken them. They were a gift from a very powerful Void cultivator who lived during the Primordial Era. I stumbled upon a trial he left during the Chaos Era of the Infinity Universe, and after passing it, these wings were handed to me.
Since then, they have been mine."

Parand stood stunned for a few minutes before a smile appeared on her face. "I don’t really care where you got the wings from. As long as you can cultivate the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings, we will all witness the power of the infamous Jade Void Wings."
She transferred the technique to Kent in less than five minutes, then walked back to her seat.
Kent was a bit stunned by all that had just happened, but he brushed the lingering effects aside and focused on the next important details.

Once that is achieved, you will have to channel Abyssal Energy and Chaos Energy to refine your Chaos Heart until you achieve all nine stages."
"Which stage have you reached currently?" Kent asked.
"The 4th stage, still nowhere near the 5th stage.
But even if I get stuck here, I have enough energy to keep me going until I reach the Universe Stage."
"Wow, that sounds incredible."
Tumenk smiled and answered, "That it does.
However, it would take time to cultivate even a single stage, so for now, I will transfer it to you and provide more than enough treasures to aid you in reaching at least the first stage."
A few minutes later, he walked back to his seat, and the last tribe leader stood up.
Parand narrowed her eyes at Kent for a few seconds before she spoke, "I can sense a familiar wing treasure on you, kid.
Do you happen to have a pair of Chaos Storm Wings?"
She summoned her four pairs of metallic wings, causing Kent to raise his brow.
Then he also summoned the Jade Void Wings.
The moment the wings appeared, Parand’s eyes widened, and she quickly moved toward them.
She touched both pairs as if to see if they were the ones she remembered.
As expected, they were the ones mentioned in the records.
"I believe these are called Jade Void Wings," she asked, and Kent nodded.
Her eyes sparkled upon getting the confirmation.
This made Kent and everyone else wonder why she was crying.
Naturally, she gave them the answer a few minutes later.
"My tribe cultivates the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings, perhaps the deadliest flight-type technique in the world if your comprehension is deep enough.
However, to cultivate the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings, you need to first awaken a wing."
She gestured toward her wings and continued, "Mine are the Flame Chaos Wings, meant to harness both the flame and chaos.
Depending on which wings you awaken, you will have a dedicated cultivation method for them.
Over the years, rumors have circulated that when the Chaos Ascension King bestowed the technique on the first ancestor, he mentioned a wing that harnesses the power of the Void.
This wing, if awakened, is destined to become the first ever to reach nine pairs and be unparalleled by all.
We have tried for years to awaken it, but have failed every time.
Never in my wildest dreams did I expect it to appear here today, and with someone who doesn’t even have the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings cultivation art."
She looked Kent in the eye and asked, "How did you awaken the wings?"
"I didn’t awaken them.
They were a gift from a very powerful Void cultivator who lived during the Primordial Era.
I stumbled upon a trial he left during the Chaos Era of the Infinity Universe, and after passing it, these wings were handed to me.
Since then, they have been mine."
Parand stood stunned for a few minutes before a smile appeared on her face.
"I don’t really care where you got the wings from.
As long as you can cultivate the Heaven Splitting Chaos Wings, we will all witness the power of the infamous Jade Void Wings."
She transferred the technique to Kent in less than five minutes, then walked back to her seat.
Kent was a bit stunned by all that had just happened, but he brushed the lingering effects aside and focused on the next important details.

chapters.title: Chapter 1778: Third Awakening & Formations (1)
paragraphs: With all seven techniques transferred to him, Kent felt blessed by an existence far beyond his understanding. However, he also understood the obligations he had to fulfill to live up to their expectations.
He couldn’t slack off, especially with the 37 years he still had left to cultivate.

"We have given you the techniques. What is left to do now is to cultivate them when you are ready. Of course, to prepare you, we will be giving you treasures that will aid you in cultivating the techniques," Jyoti Lata announced, and the rest of the Eternals nodded.
Parand took over. "You said you will be forming the next Chaos Heart and the third Demon Body before handling the techniques, right?"
Kent nodded in confirmation...
"Then what do you need to get that done?"
Kent listed all the items he needed, and when he was done, they just nodded, and Parand replied, "We will make them available within an hour. For now, you can go back and start preparing."
"Thank you, Seniors. I will do my best to impress all of you."
"Hahahahaha," Veylan Seren laughed, waving his hand. "Don’t worry about it, kid. You have already impressed me with your sense of humor."
Kent just smiled and turned to leave. Naturally, Fiannarel followed him.

"I will be staying by your side for the next couple of years. And before you try to say I will get hurt, know that I am a Real Eternal, so even if you give it your all, you can’t leave a scratch mark on my skin."
Kent smiled and replied, taking her hand, "I would have asked you to stay by my side even if you hadn’t asked."
Fiannarel smiled happily, seeing how much Kent trusted her. They left the building and began heading back to the cultivation grounds.
Along the way, many tribe members of the Red Bone Chaos Tribe kept staring at them, but Kent and his sister ignored them.

"So I want to know, what happened to those two wives of yours?" Fiannarel asked. "I know you always said they were your girlfriends, but you couldn’t fool my keen eyes back then, so I knew they meant the world to you. What happened to them?"

Kent first smiled, then sighed. "They both fell during the Sun War. Akemi died taking down a Pseudo-Primordial Stage Sun Demon and a few thousand Celestials with her, and Meiro single-handedly protected our home planet from hundreds of thousands of sun demons.
I wasn’t there when they died, but the messages they left behind before the final battle told me they were already prepared to die for me."
Fiannarel hugged Kent’s arm. "I am sorry, little brother."
Kent just smiled and confidently said, "Don’t worry about it, big sister. I am pretty sure they have already awakened and are waiting for me to come and get them."
She smirked. "I forgot you had allegedly figured out reincarnation."
Kent laughed, but he didn’t deny what she said. "You will understand when you meet the rest of my wives. Oh, I have over 30 wives now."
Fiannarel stopped and looked at Kent with a questioning gaze for a few seconds before shaking her head. "Unbelievable."

Kent laughed out loud as he entered the training hall he had been given to cultivate in. "My existence is a bit complex, so be sure not to get carried away too much when you start to witness some of that weirdness."
"I will keep an open mind then."
"That would be for the best, trust me."
Kent settled down on the cultivation mat, and Fiannarel walked to the sofa she had created and sat down. "How about Mother and those two troublemakers?"

"Mother survived and continues to rule the empire like before. Before I entered reincarnation, I helped her reach the Pseudo-Primordial Stage, so perhaps she has already become a Primordial after a couple of eras have passed.

As for big brother Legan and big sister Kavita, they had this crazy plan to venture into the Universe Ocean to live out the rest of the eras there. However, they promised to return if the universe ever found itself in danger again, so maybe we will see them again."
"I see. It appears I’ve missed a lot," Fiannarel said with a sigh...

"Rest assured, big sister, when we return, we will look for Mother and the rest of our siblings and have a family reunion. I am sure the old man would have reincarnated already and is probably jumping from one battlefield to another."
Fiannarel smiled and nodded.
The two siblings continued to talk for a couple more minutes until Jyoti Lata arrived with the treasures prepared by the seven tribe leaders for Kent.
"Good luck, Kent."
After handing over the storage bag, she vanished into thin air, reappearing in the hall where the rest of the tribe leaders were waiting.
Kent opened the bag, and with a wave of his hand, over a million drops of blood essence appeared in the air. He accessed the other storage bag and retrieved all the blood essence he had left.
"I will be going under for the next couple of months, perhaps years, big sister. Make sure you don’t miss me too much," Kent said, flashing a smile...
"I will miss you terribly, but I am an Eternal, so I have my ways to pass the time as if it never even went by."
Kent looked at her for a few seconds before shaking his head. Then he closed his eyes, and the blood essence began to enter his forehead.

In no time, thousands of drops of blood essence had entered his forehead and appeared inside his Soul Sea. Kent sat at the center of the Blood Platform, looking up at the blood essence that just kept coming.

"Very well, it is time to awaken the third blood gate." Kent formed a hand seal, and at once, the blood essence surged forward, entering a section of the platform where the third Blood Gate would emerge.
Somewhere inside the infinite expanse of the Void, a blood-red eye with streaks of gold, black, and purple slowly opened, causing the space around it to collapse.
It was as if this eye wasn’t meant to open, since the mere act of parting its eyelids seemed to destabilize reality and cause the Void to collapse in on itself.
Without blinking, the eye locked onto a lone target, and for a moment, amusement could be seen within it. However, after watching for a few minutes, it closed again.
Before it completely shut, however, the image of a tower with thirteen floors appeared within its pupil before vanishing into the Void.
The eye closed, and afterward, a sigh that seemed to resonate throughout the Void, spreading across the Universe Ocean, came from the being whose eye had just opened and closed.
Somewhere else, far away, six people slowly opened their eyes from a slumber that seemed to have lasted for billions of years.
One of them, a man forged through battle and blood, sighed before smiling. He looks very dangerous even with his eyes closed. When he opened them, it felt like the universe could bow before his gaze.
"Finally, it is happening."
The second person, a man who seemed to have been forged from lightning, also smiled.
"A worthy opponent is coming," he said, and the rest let out a low hum.

chapters.title: Chapter 1779: Third Awakening & Formations (2)
paragraphs: RUMBLE
The entire soul sea shook, and Kent, who was seated in a lotus posture, snapped his eyes open and gazing up at the blood-red sky, where billions, perhaps trillions, of blood runes snaked about.
The blood sea surged, and the space around the Blood Platform seemed to become unstable.
However, despite all that had happened, more blood runes were still being devoured by the Blood Platform, and more blood essence also kept entering his soul sea from the outside.
Seated on the sofa, Fiannarel, who had been standing guard for nine months already, smiled as she sensed the change around Kent.
’He is getting closer to the awakening,’ she said inwardly and continued to remain vigilant despite knowing no harm would come from anywhere.
Even so, because of how overprotected she had been in the past, she chose to remain the same for him this time around, too.
A few hours later, a powerful explosion of blood aura emanated from Kent’s body, and the entire city was filled with an overwhelming amount of blood qi, the kind a Demigod wasn’t expected to possess.

This alarmed many, but the person causing it remained seated on the cultivation mat, while now, he was hovering midair within his soul sea, watching as a red-and-black gate slowly rose from the ground.

The first Blood Gate was red and green, while the second was red and brown. As the third rose up, waves of blood qi started to pour out of it even more, filling his entire soul sea with the power of blood.
On the outside too, the blood qi continued to spread, becoming denser as the minutes passed.

A couple of days passed, and the process hadn’t ended. Meanwhile, the third Blood Gate had already risen to a staggering 140,000 km tall. However, compared to the 350,000 km height of the first and second Blood Gates, it still had quite a bit more to rise.
Thankfully, about a week later, it was done with the awakening...
<Congratulations, you have awakened the third Blood Gate>
<You can now form the third Blood Core and any other cores>
Kent smiled, then started forming the Blood Core right away. He knew he had no time to spare, so he got right to it.
Thankfully, he still had more than enough blood essence to use.
Time soon passed, and before long, the core started to take shape, coming together steadily. He remained busy, absorbing more blood essence.

About a year later, bringing the total to roughly 15 years of the 50-year period, the third Blood Core formed, and, like a madman, he started saturating it, using the opportunity to raise his cultivation from the Low-Level Demigod stage to the Peak Demigod stage.
After five months, Kent had reached the Peak Demigod stage, and his Blood Core had finally formed.
He considered refining his blood further to raise his bloodline awakening from 40% to at least 45%, but he knew it would take time, so he put that on hold and turned to the next set of items.
He opened his eyes only to meet the stunned gaze of Fiannarel, who was now crouching before him...
"Uhm, big sister, why do I feel like you want to cut me open and experiment on me?" Kent asked with a smile.
"Because I want to cut you open and experiment on you. Just what kind of monster are you? This aura isn’t something a Demigod should have. Even Celestials don’t have this kind of aura."
Kent laughed and replied, "If you are impressed by what you have seen, then wait until you meet the Paragon."
Fiannarel’s eyes widened. "Huh, you know the Paragon?"
Kent laughed and replied with a smug expression, "He is my sworn brother. Although he thinks he is good-looking, we both know he is merely exaggerating."

Fiannarel looked long and hard at Kent and sighed. "You know, the person most of the Chaos Ancestors have been looking for is the Paragon. They claim that a very long time ago, he met the Chaos Ascension King, so if they want to find his whereabouts, they need to first find the Paragon."
"Good luck to them, I suppose. In any case, I will be forming my third Chaos Heart and other cores, so see you in the next couple of years."
Fiannarel could only watch Kent slip back into cultivation, leaving her wondering just what kind of existence her brother was. It was as if, at every turn, he had something shocking to reveal.

Revealing that he knew the Paragon was supposed to be funny in a way. But Fiannarel knew he wasn’t lying. It was one of the things she liked about her baby brother: he didn’t lie, at least not to her.
So she knew he indeed knew the Paragon. The only parts that seemed like lies to her were the sworn brother part and the "who is good-looking" part.
At least she could tell Kent believed what he had said, so she could only wonder just how good-looking the Paragon was.
She took a deep breath and started to wait again.

Seven months into the wait, Kent formed the third Chaos Heart and moved on to the third Flame Core. That also took seven months, then he quickly moved on to the Evil Core, which took a year and a half.
The other cores soon followed, with the Ice Core taking eight months and the Lightning Core taking nine months. Afterward, he spent a few more months saturating them all.
When that was done, he moved on to cultivating the third Demon Body, knowing that it would take a few more years. Surprisingly, when he began, he soon saw the process wasn’t as hard as before.
This brought a smile to his face.
So he continued to cultivate for months.
Exactly twenty years after he started cultivating in the Red Bone Chaos Tribe, Kent had successfully formed the third of everything.
The third Blood Gate had awakened, and all three forms of the Blood Core, Chaos Heart, Flame Core, Evil Core, Ice Core, and Lightning Core had formed.
Aside from them, the third Demon Body of the Nine Demon Body Tempering Art had also been fully cultivated, raising his strength past that of someone below the True Celestial stage.
To make matters even more exciting, just when he was done cultivating the third Demon Body, the tower entered an upgrade mode.
Kent had no idea what had triggered it, since the tower had already informed him that until she merged back with her other part in the Infinity Universe, she could not upgrade to Tier 2.

Now, she had entered an upgrade mode, and Kent could only wait to see what she would become after she ascended to Tier 2. Maybe he could re-enter the tower or contact his wives. Regardless, he can only wait.
In the meantime, Kent opened his eyes and started chatting with his sister while he waited for the tower to be done.
He knew she would not leave his side for as long as she had nothing to do. Since he had a lot to say and she seemed like a good conversation partner, they kept talking for weeks.
Unfortunately, two months into their chat, Kent was forced to return to work because the tower was about to awaken, and he wanted to witness everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1780: Overpowered Techniques (1)
paragraphs: Instead of appearing inside his soul sea, Kent found himself in a void-like space where, aside from a small light in the distance, everything else was nothingness and darkness.
The light was very faint and distant.
However, Kent had been here before, so the moment he appeared, he knew what came next. Suddenly, the light grew brighter, and when it dimmed, an elegant tower appeared, surrounded by a golden glow.
Kent recognized it at once. However, he couldn’t help but narrow his eyes a bit at the tower, which now looked more real than before.
When he first saw the tower’s true form, he knew she was merely a manifestation of cosmic energy. However, now she looked like a real artifact made by a real artisan.
This left him a bit stunned. However, he pushed it to the back of his mind and instead focused on the important part, which was the messages floating before him...
<Your Primordial Chaos Tower has been upgraded to Tier 2>
<You can now access the Tower Space>
<Caution: Because you are outside the known universe, privileges to access the Tower Space have been revoked>
<Backdoor access is blocked. You must return to the known universe to access the Tower Space and enjoy its other benefits.>
<Tower is analyzing your cultivation to determine how best to aid you>
<The Tower has discovered seven cultivation paths you can cultivate. The Tower has chosen the first path for you to cultivate.>
<Congratulations, you can now cultivate the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique>
<Cultivate to at least 25% of the first stage to unlock the second path>
Kent read through the messages, and for a moment, he only smiled.

While he still couldn’t enter the tower or talk to anyone, he at least now knew which path to take first and how to cultivate the seven techniques without overloading his core. Taking the wrong route would have some consequences atleast.
If he followed the tower’s arrangement, considering everything about to happen to him was beyond normal, there was a chance he would walk out of this as a powerhouse worthy of his name.
"This is for the best, I guess," Kent muttered, looking at the messages one last time. After he was done reading everything, he closed the system interface and turned to the tower.
"Congratulations on the upgrade, Tower."

<Thank you, Master. Although I am not strong enough to bypass the laws left behind by the Chaos Ascension King and allow you to enter the Tower Space, I can feel a much clearer connection to the other version of me in the Infinity Universe.
I was able to determine that your wives are fine, and now they will know that you are fine as well. Aside from that, I also calculated that one year here is equal to one day in the Infinity Universe.
This means that even if you spend 100 years here, only 100 days will have passed there. So you have more time, Master. No need to worry too much.>
"That is good to hear, Tower."

While he couldn’t speak directly to his wives, hearing that they were fine put his mind at ease. Knowing how chaotic Pandora could be sometimes, he had been a bit worried they would go after the bastard who had caused all this.

He didn’t want them to go after him, since even one mistake would bring the entire Soul Temple down on them. And if they failed to enter the tower before being surrounded, then that would be the end of them.
So he was pleased to hear they had heeded his warning and were safe.
"Since that is the case, then how about we get started with the first technique? The earlier we get things done, the faster we both get to return home."
He opened his eyes and turned to Fiannarel, who was relaxing in the chair, looking back at him.
"I guess congratulations are in order, little bro," she said with a smile.

Kent nodded and replied, "I was lucky to have found myself here when I did. If I were still in the Infinity Universe, it would have taken me years and a lot of resources to accomplish a quarter of what I have now."
"Then I suppose you should be happy with what you have now and work hard to accomplish more."
Kent nodded. "That is the plan. I will be learning one of the techniques now. I don’t know how long it will take, but whatever happens, don’t panic."
She nodded. "Good luck then."
Kent closed his eyes, and then he tapped into the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique technique. The moment he did, his consciousness appeared in a space covered in stones and metal.
GONG
A gong sounded, and then humming sounds started to resound across the space. At once, Kent felt a foreboding presence closing in on him from every direction.
’Tower, what is the first form of this technique?’ Kent asked, knowing he had to complete 25% of it before he could cultivate the second path, or technique.
The humming doesn’t sound like confidence to him.
If, after becoming an Overlord, something was able to scare him, then who was to say what was coming wasn’t worse than anything he had ever laid his eyes on?
<The first form is called Obsidian Skin. You have to temper your skin to attain an Undying Obsidian Skin, or as the Obsidian Scale Chaos Tribe calls it, the Undying Obsidian Body.
I don’t know how to cultivate it, since the technique says everyone has their own unique way, so maybe yours is the one that’s coming.>
The humming grew louder, and before long, Kent saw a large furnace-shaped building appear through the clouds and slowly begin descending.
BANG
Kent was struck by a terrifying pressure, sending him to his knees. His bones became soft, and for the first time in his life, he became powerless.
He could only remain on his knees, endure the pressure, and hope it would end soon.
Meanwhile, on the outside, the building that Kent had been cultivating inside came undone, its walls reduced to powder. Fiannarel now stood 20 km away beside the seven tribe leaders.
Veylan Seren, the leader of the Obsidian Scale Chaos Tribe, held a shocked expression on his face as he looked at Kent, seated in a lotus posture with a furnace tattoo on his forehead.
"You know, if before I doubted he had some connection to the Chaos Ascension King, then now I think he is related to him by blood."
"Why the change of mind?" Borislav asked, trying to understand why Veylan Seren had said that...

"The symbol on his forehead is the symbol of the Undying Obsidian Furnace, the ultimate tempering treasure and the pinnacle of the tempering treasures of my tribe. According to the records, only the Chaos Ascension King could invoke it.
It was said that awakening it would allow the cultivator to cultivate the Three Undying Bodies that came with the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique."

He took a deep breath and added, "The first is the Undying Obsidian Body, which I have cultivated. The second is the Undying Golden Body, which the First and Third Ancestors have cultivated. The last, and perhaps one I will be seeing for the first time ever, is the Undying Immortal Body.
Legends have it that attaining an Undying Immortal Body allows one to leave their body behind and, even after reincarnation, return to reclaim it.
Their body would no longer die, no matter what happened to them. More importantly, the Undying Immortal Body forges the person’s body into a living weapon."
He smiled and added, "Now, imagine someone who has cultivated Three Demon Bodies and is now about to temper his body into an Undying Obsidian Body."
Fiannarel smiled slightly from the side and said inwardly, ’Proud of you, little bro.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1781: Overpowered Techniques (2)
paragraphs: When Kent asked Fiannarel how far she had advanced on the path of the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique, she said the third form, the Obsidian Dragon Core.
He wanted to laugh and say she was rather slow after spending billions of years cultivating one technique.
However, when Tower informed him he only needed to cultivate the Undying Obsidian Skin to 25% completion, he finally understood the kind of monstrous technique he was about to cultivate.
Now, if he learned that aside from 25% mastery of the Undying Obsidian Body, he would also have to cultivate two more stages after fully cultivating the Undying Obsidian Body, he would probably cry.

When he was done with the Undying Obsidian Body, which is the peak for everyone, he would have to go on to cultivate the Undying Golden Body and, lastly, the Undying Immortal Body before he could count himself as someone who was done cultivating the first form of the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique, the Obsidian Skin.
He still had a long way to go...
But first, he had to endure the pressure from the Undying Obsidian Furnace...

"If he fails to endure the awakening of the Undying Obsidian Furnace, it means he cannot cultivate the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique," Veylan Seren said, causing the tribe leaders to wish deep in their hearts that Kent would succeed.
Kent remained inside the strange space for hours, the Undying Obsidian Furnace much closer to the ground now. However, he was totally at the mercy of the pressure.
Luckily, just when he was at his wits’ end, the Undying Obsidian Furnace touched the ground, and the pressure vanished.
HUMMMMM

A loud hum came from it, and then a spirit figure clad in tattered monk attire appeared in the air and formed a couple of hand seals. Suddenly, the side of the Undying Obsidian Furnace opened, and he spoke.

"The path forward is through fire and refinement. You must undergo extreme refinement to be able to attain the legendary Undying Immortal Body. It is a path forward, not backward, so walk it without looking back."
WHOOOSH
From the door that had opened on the side of the Undying Obsidian Furnace, Kent saw green flames wash out, causing his body to tremble.
<I believe the master should enter the door,> Tower said, perhaps misinterpreting Kent’s fear as hesitation.
He rose to his feet and answered, "I know, Tower. Just give me a few minutes to gather my thoughts." Kent took a deep breath, and then he exhaled.
Afterward, he started walking toward the door. After a few steps, he stood before the gate. Then, with a sigh, he walked inside, and the door shut behind him.
"ARRRRRRGGGGHHHHH"
Kent let out a thunderous shout the moment he stepped into the Undying Obsidian Furnace. On the outside, green flames engulfed his body, eating away at his clothes and bathing him in a sea of flames.
Fiannarel panicked, but she recalled what Kent had said before entering.
He made it clear that once he begins his cultivation, she cannot interrupt him, no matter what happens. She clenched her fist and started paying attention to him for now.
A few minutes into his cultivation, everyone felt an overwhelming amount of Divine Qi start to come out of his body...
"Looks like he had comprehended Divine Qi. What a monster," Parand said, looking at Kent with interest. The rest of the Eternals wore the same expression as her, all of them impressed.
However, their impressed looks soon turned to shock when Supreme Qi began to flow from Kent’s body. What was even more shocking was the density of the Supreme Qi around him.
"Holy moly, this is unreal," Zdzislav, who could see more than everyone else, shouted, his gaze locked on Kent, whose presence was now surrounded by thick Supreme Qi.
"What in the name of the Chaos Ascension King is happening right now?" Namarie exclaimed, unable to understand why Kent was releasing Supreme Qi.
Fiannarel smiled. "Somehow, I think my little brother is comprehending the various energies that lead up to Eternal Qi."
"Was that something he was capable of in the past?" Borislav asked, but Fiannarel shook her head.

"No. However, what you all have to know is, if before he was a monster, then now, even I don’t know what he has become. But I know this, he is not done yet, so I would advise you all to do as he advised me."
"And that is?" Parand asked.
"Keep an open mind."
Just when she said that, everyone’s eyes narrowed when, between the release of the Divine Qi and the Supreme Qi, Celestial Qi started to fill the air.
It came faintly at first, but as time passed, it grew denser. In less than a month, the Celestial Qi around Kent grew so dense that even Celestial Kings would struggle beneath it.

Five months later, the amount of Divine Qi, Supreme Qi, and Celestial Qi around Kent grew so potent that it became visible to the naked eye. The Divine Qi appeared silver, the Supreme Qi blue, and the Celestial Qi yellow.
It had also become so powerful that even the Eternals could sense the power hidden within.
However, a year into his cultivation, 21 years since he had started, something else began to happen. Just when everyone thought he could not move on to Primordial Qi, something else happened.
His other energies, mainly his Chaos Qi, Blood Qi, and Evil Qi, surged, and a mutation began to form, instantly filling the space around him with power.
The moment the energy appeared, the Eternals sensed something extremely powerful coming from the heavens and covering Kent in a beam of light.
At once, everyone lost sight of Kent. The beam that fell upon him blocked their senses.
However, they knew he wasn’t in danger, not when they could still sense his mutating energies.
Meanwhile, seated within the light, Kent remained submerged in the flames, his body being refined by the Undying Obsidian Furnace.
The beam remained for three years. However, during those three years, many things happened to Kent, including his Sword Energy finally reaching the rank of Extreme Divine Sword Energy.

On this day, after spending five years inside the Undying Obsidian Furnace, a powerful explosion of energy so foreign and lethal that, for the first time, the Eternals had to use their energy to shield themselves erupted from Kent.
BOOM BOOM BOOM
Three more explosions came from his body, and then the light shrouding him dispersed, revealing Kent seated in a lotus posture.
However, regardless of how one looked at it, the Kent seated there now wasn’t the same Kent they had known five years ago. He was still Kent, but with a body that was beyond anything and anyone.
"He-He had completed the Undying Obsidian Body Tempering in just five years," Veylan Seren shouted, his voice startling everyone.
They were soon left in shock after fully digesting what Veylan Seren had said.

"You can’t be serious, right?" Tumenk asked, his gaze fixed on Kent, but his words directed at Veylan Seren. "The last I checked, the fastest anyone from your tribe ever cultivated the Undying Obsidian Body was 30,000 years, and that was a very long time ago.
Are you saying this kid, who isn’t even a god yet, used just five years to cultivate that?"
Veylan Seren turned and looked at Tumenk. "I don’t know what you want to hear, but he did indeed cultivate it. I know because I can feel it."
"Veylan Seren is right, the kid had fully cultivated the Undying Obsidian Body," Zdzislav said, adding to the tense atmosphere.

chapters.title: Chapter 1782: Overpowered Techniques (3)
paragraphs: This training arc is fun to write, because I can finally handle all the cultvating arts Kent need to keep advancing. We won’t have to spend more Chapters in the future worrying about cultivation Arts and other core evolution.

However, I promise that when he returns to the Infinity Universe, he will spend time with his wives, both those present and those he has yet to reunite with. Also, expect a series of family reunions. Writing a long-ass novel isn’t as easy as I thought.]
<Congratulations, you have successfully cultivated the Undying Obsidian Body>
<Your Three Demon Bodies have undergone evolution>
<Congratulations, your Three Demon Bodies are now Three Undying Demon Bodies>
<Congratulations, you have unlocked Flawless Tempering>
<You can now move ahead and cultivate the Void Vein Chaos Scripture>
Many messages followed, telling Kent what he had achieved and how much impact it had on him. The power surging through his body now was just too much for him to understand or put into words.
All he knew was that he had become more powerful than he was five years ago, and it was all because he had fully cultivated the Undying Obsidian Body.
He was supposed to cultivate it to only 25%. However, things took a dark turn, and before he knew it, he had fully cultivated it.
"Still, I can sense that I am not done with the first form of the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique," Kent said, and Tower replied to him...

<That is true. You seem to have triggered the peak of the first form of this technique. So after this first achievement, you need to achieve the Undying Golden Body and finally, the Undying Immortal Body.>
"Undying Immortal Body. I have heard about it before."
Kent thought about it for a few minutes, trying to recall where he had heard it. After a few minutes, his mind went to a conversation he had with Leviathan during the Primordial Era.

"According to Leviathan, hidden somewhere in the Primordial Chaos is a technique that, when fully comprehended, allows the body to remain alive even if the soul dies. He wanted to go get it and even wanted me to join him on that campaign.
Had it not been for the Void Beast invasion, I would have joined his mission. To think such a terrifying technique is merely the first form of the Obsidian Chaos Dragon Physique."
Kent could only smile slightly and wish he could cultivate it right now.
"Tower, how long would it take to cultivate the Undying Immortal Body?"
<It would take the master between 10 and 100 years to achieve the Undying Golden Body and between 100 and 1,000 years to achieve the Undying Immortal Body.

However, the duration may shorten once the master has cultivated the other techniques. After all, the stronger you become, the faster you will make progress with the other cultivation techniques. The next is the Void Vein Chaos Scripture, and the master is required to form at least two Void Veins.>
"Form? I thought they were already there and I could connect to them."
<That is true, but unless the master wants to be limited by how large and powerful the Void Veins are, the master is advised to form his own and later improve them.>
"I see. Then what are we waiting for?"
Kent dove back in, and this time, he appeared inside the void, surrounded by thousands of wolf-type Void Beasts. The moment he sensed them, they also sensed him and attacked.
"What the hell?"
<This is the Infinity Void Expanse, where each kill adds to the formation of the Void Vein. You must kill and keep killing until you form two Void Veins.>
Kent’s hand moved, and Gaap appeared in his firm grip. Then, as if he had been possessed, a wave of anger buried deep within him since the Primordial Era ignited, and his aura flared.
At once, he went from being just Kent to a terrifying Demi-Dragon driven by vengeance. He began cutting through the thousands of wolves, each a terrifying powerhouse filled with refined Void Essence.
The more he attacked, the more it felt like his understanding of the void was improving.
Naturally, on the outside, the moment Void Essence started to flow around Kent, Borislav smiled. "So he decided to cultivate the Void Vein Chaos Scripture next, huh?"
The others sensed it, and knowing what he had achieved with the first technique, they all became excited and ready to witness another milestone. They wanted to witness something incredible.
And Kent delivered.
The first sign appeared six months into his cultivation when, all of a sudden, Kent’s body started releasing so much Void Qi, which caused everyone to retreat.
Initially, everyone thought he had connected to the first Void Vein since that was the objective. However, Borislav, the expert on all things void, sensed something different.
However, he kept quiet and waited a few more months to confirm his suspicions. Four months later, he finally burst into resounding laughter and shouted...
"Brilliant, this kid is brilliant. Not only has he formed his own Void Vein, but instead of forming it outside his body, he formed it inside his body."
This time, even Fiannarel’s eyes widened. "You can’t be serious, right? Forming a Void Vein inside the body is a suicide move. Surely, you must be mistaken."

"But I am not, my dear. This kid has indeed formed it within himself. Somehow, he figured out a way to form a Void Core and, using it as a medium, attached a Void Vein to it." Borislav laughed again, and Veylan Seren joined him.

"But it has only been ten months since he started cultivating the Void Vein Chaos Scripture. How could he form a Void Core and a Void Vein within such a short period of time?" Parand asked, utterly shocked.
"Beats me," Borislav replied.

"All I know is that when I cultivated the first form of the Void Vein Chaos Scripture, I had to climb a mountain where the higher you climbed, the more Void Essence you could absorb. Maybe he got the same trial, but he is much faster than I was.
Or maybe he got something else entirely, and that’s what we are seeing now. Maybe he even..."Borislav stopped himself...

Zdzislav, whose perception was on another level, kept a close eye on Kent, not blinking even for a moment. He had been doing so for weeks, looking to see something extraordinary, and just now, he finally blinked and said...
"I don’t know what he is doing, but I am 90% sure it involves fighting and slaughter."
"Why do you say that?" Fiannarel asked, worried and happy at the same time.
"Because for the past ten months, while you all were focused on the Void Energy around him, I have been paying attention to his Sword Energy and Killing Intent.
At the start of his cultivation, he had a calm, almost concealed Killing Intent, but it soon spiked to a much higher level and has been climbing ever since, becoming more refined and sharper.
The only way that would happen is if he had invoked a trial that involved fighting."
Everyone turned to Borislav, who had a look of pale shock on his face. "But that can’t be right. He isn’t the Chaos Ascension King, right?"
"Why is that...?" Namarie asked, her flowery green hair falling to the side of her face.
"If what Zdzislav said is true, then I think he has invoked the trial called the Infinity Void Expanse."
"No way."
The Eternals exclaimed, everyone shifting their gaze back to Kent, who now had even more Void Essence surrounding him.
It appeared he was making more headway with this technique than with the first one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1783: Overpowered Techniques (4)
paragraphs: Every tribe has that one mysterious level nobody has managed to reach since the Chaos Ascension King left the Chaos Chasm billions of years ago.

To the Obsidian Scale Chaos Tribe, it was the Undying Obsidian Furnace, which is said to possess the power to temper the body of the one who awakens it from the Undying Obsidian Body to the Undying Immortal Body.

The Void Vein Chaos Tribe had the legend of the Infinity Void Expanse, where the person who awakens it fights and kills beasts made purely of Void Essence, and the more they kill, the more Void Essence they absorb.
It was said that this method is the fastest way to rise from nothing to the top in void cultivation.
Both methods are ones both tribes have pursued whenever a new prodigy emerged within their tribe, yet they have never once managed to awaken either of them.
Yet, in a twist of fate, Kent appeared and, within a decade, awakened both. More shocking was that each time, he awakens this method flawlessly and easily, almost as if he had no resistance at all.
Who is to say he wouldn’t awaken the ones meant for the other techniques?
[A year and a half into the Void Vein Chaos Scripture cultivation]

Kent opened his eyes, causing the space around him to begin cracking. Soon, the void shattered around him, and waves of Void Essence poured out. However, as if he were a black hole, all the essence that emerged was absorbed into his body.
Before him, a series of messages was displayed.
<Congratulations, you have formed your first Void Core>
<Your understanding of the void has improved tremendously>
<Congratulations, you have formed your first Void Vein>
<Void Vein has been connected to the Void Core>
<You can now automatically and directly absorb Void Essence straight from the void>
<Congratulations, you have formed your third Void Core>
<Your understanding of the void has improved tremendously>
<Congratulations, you have formed your third Void Vein>
Kent looked at the messages, and for a moment, he simply lifted his head and laughed.
In just a year and a half, he had formed three Void Cores and three Void Veins, connecting each Void Vein to its respective Void Core, giving him direct access to the void.
Right now, the only reason he would get tired in combat is if his body gave out after enduring too much stress. However, he was a body cultivator and, more importantly, a dragon.
Getting tired would be difficult by all standards. In fact, what hinders most powerhouses isn’t their bodies getting tired but rather their energy becoming exhausted.

However, Kent now had an almost infinite supply of energy within him. So long as the amount of energy he unleashed did not exceed the rate at which he regenerated it, he would never suffer from energy exhaustion.
But even if his expenditure is more than his absorption, he looked at the next technique he would be cultivating, and a smile formed on his face...
<You can now move ahead and cultivate the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art>

Kent didn’t waste much time and dived right into the next technique. He knew he still had time to spare, but the sooner he mastered all the techniques, the faster he would be able to return to his wives and loved ones.
When Kent opened his eyes, he found himself in the middle of a blood sea filled with millions, perhaps billions, of gigantic bones.
Skulls the size of mountains could be seen, while spines that pierced the clouds towered over the endless blood sea.
"And it gets weirder and weirder."

<Welcome to the Endless Blood and Bone Sea. To proceed to the next stage of the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art, you must devour both blood and bones and use their essence to refine your bones until you attain the Golden Blood Demon Bones.>
"No fighting this time, huh?" A smile formed on his face, and then, tapping into the cultivation method within the technique, Kent started devouring both the blood and the bones.
The colossal bones under his command kept turning into streams of energy containing trillions of tiny runes before entering his body.
On the outside, Kent’s skin dissolved, revealing only his skeletal structure.
Jyoti Lata smiled when she saw this.
"I guess he decided to go ahead and cultivate the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art next."
Her happiness caused the others to roll their eyes.
However, the next moment, her eyes widened, and so did everyone else’s.
"Are those Primordial Runes?" Parand asked, adding, "Surely, I must be seeing things... right?"

"No, you are seeing perfectly fine. Those are indeed Primordial Runes," Zdzislav answered. "The question here is, how can a Demigod absorb Primordial Runes and, more importantly, how is he not dead yet?"

"Zdzislav is right. Why is he still alive? Isn’t it the first cardinal rule that when cultivating the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art, one must start from Divine Runes and work their way up? How can he start from the Primordial grade?"
Jyoti Lata had become pale, but almost as if she had fallen in love, she blushed and answered,

"That is because he has invoked the infamous Endless Blood and Bone Sea. The First Ancestor once said that according to the Chaos Ascension King, when one invokes the Endless Blood and Bone Sea, they can absorb runes of any grade to temper their bones, so long as they can comprehend that grade of rune."
"So then are you saying this kid’s comprehension speed is great enough to comprehend Primordial Runes?" Namarie asked, and this time, it was Fiannarel who answered.
"Well, my little brother could comprehend Celestial-grade techniques to perfection by merely looking at them, so I think he is more than qualified to comprehend Primordial Runes."
"So what does this mean?" Tumenk asked, wondering if everything that was happening was real or merely an illusion. He even suspected that Zdzislav had cast an illusion on them just to mess with them.

However, seeing everyone there, including Zdzislav, with constantly changing expressions, he knew this was the real deal, so he asked, knowing that every technique left behind by the Chaos Ascension King had different levels depending on one’s talent.

"The First Ancestor said that when it comes to the first form of the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art, there are seven levels of bone tempering. The first is the Golden Blood Demon Bones. The second is the Diamond Blood Demon Bones. The third is the Void Devouring Demon Bones.
That is where most people in my tribe stop before moving on to the second form of the technique.

However, some have managed to reach the Chaos Sovereign Bones, while I reached the Primordial Origin Bones. Beyond the fifth stage lies the Eternal Devouring Bones, which only those who have invoked the Blood River and Bone Grave can attain.

The First, Second, and Fourth Ancestors all reached that stage. However, for the final stage, only the Endless Blood and Bone Sea can help one achieve it, and that stage is known as the Chaos Ascension Emperor Bones.
If Kent has truly invoked it, then maybe we should all start packing our things because we will soon be leaving this world."
Jyoti Lata laughed, and Fiannarel laughed with her.
"Jyoti Lata is right. We are going home because my baby brother will be taking us with him."

chapters.title: Chapter 1784: Overpowered Techniques (5)
paragraphs: [Two Months Later into the cultivation of the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art]
Kent’s skeleton had become golden, with billions of Primordial Runes covering it.

In fact, while many would say skeletons are horrible regardless of how good-looking the person they belong to is, looking at Kent’s bones now, it’s clear they were good-looking in terms of shape, structure, and appearance.
Every single one looked golden and very powerful, even just by looking at it.

Yet while this bone structure was already stronger than what most Celestials in the infinity universe have, Kent wasn’t satisfied. He asked Tower how much time had passed, and when he found that he had been cultivating for only two months, he decided to go beyond that and do more.
He chose to cultivate the [Diamond Blood Demon Bones], and if he had time, he would climax with the Void Devouring Demon Bones.
Weeks went by, and by the time the fifth month came, he had achieved the Diamond Blood Demon Bones and chose to proceed further.

"Somehow, I think achieving the Undying Obsidian Body had strengthened his bones, making the tempering process even less tasking than it should be," Jyoti Lata said, knowing full well that all Kent was doing now wasn’t normal.
It takes the best prodigy, such as herself, close to ten years to cultivate the Golden Blood Demon Bones. So, for Kent to do so in just two months, there was surely nothing normal about it.
But here lay the case that everything he had achieved now was through his own effort.

He had cultivated the Undying Obsidian Body, something many couldn’t, and now he was cultivating the Void Devouring Demon Bones, which, if he succeeded, meant he wouldn’t have to spend energy protecting his bones in combat.
They would do so themselves by using Void or any other energy in his arsenal.
"He is a monster," Zdzislav muttered, finding it hard to make sense of Kent.
But he was holding back his expectations for now until Kent was done with this technique and started cultivating the one from his tribe.

Seven months later, exactly one year since Kent had started cultivating the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art, his bones turned purple with hints of deep blue, and more importantly, they now exuded the power of the Void.
Luckily for him, he had three Void Cores and Void Veins, so his bones started to grow denser.
However, just when his skin started to cover his bones again, every last Eternal froze, their eyes narrowing toward Kent’s ten fingers, or rather, his claws.
On his finger bones, faint runes exuding the power of Eternals could be sensed. They were so faint, in fact, that many would have missed them.
However, as people who had been paying so much attention to Kent, they sensed them and knew he had awakened the Eternal Runes.
"Well, I guess we can finally say he is related to the Chaos Ascension King somehow," Tumenk said, and everyone nodded.
Fiannarel smiled and said,
"That is, if he isn’t the Chaos Ascension King in the first place."
Her words were outrageous, but the seven tribe leaders couldn’t bring themselves to dismiss them. In fact, they soon started entertaining the idea.
Meanwhile, Kent’s flesh and skin reformed, covering his skeleton. He then opened his eyes and scanned through the messages.
<You have attained Void Devouring Demon Bones>
<Your Chaos Claws have been upgraded to Chaos Void Devouring Claws>
"All in a year’s work," Kent smiled and turned to the next message, not wanting to waste any time at all.
<You can now move ahead and cultivate the World Root Chaos Scripture>
Kent smiled and began cultivating the fourth technique. He still had time, but he wasn’t about to waste it on things that wouldn’t benefit him.
The moment he began, the space around him was soon covered with plants and life.

Namarie smiled and crossed her fingers, hoping things turned out well for Kent. "Although I told him to focus on the life aspect of the World Root Chaos Scripture, if he can handle Death too, I wouldn’t mind. I wouldn’t mind at all."
Everyone nodded at her words. After all, they wanted to be free, and if what Jyoti Lata said about the Chaos Ascension King was true, then he needed the complete technique to pass the trial.
So they didn’t care how; they just wanted him to succeed.
Meanwhile, Kent appeared in a garden so vast and endless that he had no idea where it ended. It was filled with beautiful plants and birds, things that would make one want to stay inside.

However, the moment Kent appeared inside, he felt like he had stepped into the garden of death. He felt both life and death, and as someone who had seen death many times, he knew this garden was no rainbows and sunshine.
In fact, he became scared at once...
Naturally, his suspicion was confirmed when the message appeared.
<Welcome to the Upside-Down Everlasting Garden. The way forward is to split yourself in two and comprehend the life and death of all living things>
At once, the method appeared in Kent’s mind, and like a madman, he tapped into it. That was when he saw it. His body was split in half, one with green hair and the other with black hair.
The green-haired version remained in the Garden of Life, while the black-haired version appeared in a graveyard with dead trees, tombstones, and an overwhelming amount of death qi.
It appeared the Upside-Down Everlasting Garden had two sides. One side was filled with life, and when it flipped, the other side became death.
"Well, I guess Lady Namarie would be disappointed that I will be following both paths." He smiled, then closed his eyes, beginning to cultivate both energies.

Inside his soul sea, Lady Kenzie snapped her eyes open, feeling an overwhelming surge of life energy pouring into Kent’s body. Her eyes sparkled, and without hesitation, she began cultivating it to strengthen herself, which would also strengthen Kent.

On the other side, the Underworld Soul River surged, and the gates opened, revealing a terrifying sea of death. The death energy being channeled into his body had started entering the gates, refining and strengthening them.
Time soon passed, and before long, a year had passed.
Inside Kent’s soul sea, Lady Kenzie had undergone so many upgrades that she now looked like life itself. If before she had been a Celestial, then now she had become a Primordial.
She had become different, and the Tree of Life behind her seemed to reveal the kind of monster she had become.
She hovered in the air, facing someone else. This person was a man with pale white skin and a body covered in tattered black cloth. His disheveled hair flowed down his back, touching his waist.
A massive skull with glowing red eye sockets hovered imposingly behind him. This man is Death, or more accurately, the Spirit of Death.
"We are not supposed to be in the same place at the same time," Lady Kenzie said.
The man smiled and nodded. "Yet here we are, and I think we both know what needs to be done."
Lady Kenzie nodded. "I do. So why don’t we get right on that? I would love to see what Life and Death can achieve when they come together."
"Likewise."
Both moved, and when they met, they placed their palms together and closed their eyes.
On the outside, Namarie widened her eyes, staring at a Yin-Yang diagram appearing behind Kent.

"He is a monster," Zdzislav muttered, finding it hard to make sense of Kent.
But he was holding back his expectations for now until Kent was done with this technique and started cultivating the one from his tribe.

Seven months later, exactly one year since Kent had started cultivating the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art, his bones turned purple with hints of deep blue, and more importantly, they now exuded the power of the Void.
Luckily for him, he had three Void Cores and Void Veins, so his bones started to grow denser.
However, just when his skin started to cover his bones again, every last Eternal froze, their eyes narrowing toward Kent’s ten fingers, or rather, his claws.
On his finger bones, faint runes exuding the power of Eternals could be sensed.
They were so faint, in fact, that many would have missed them.
However, as people who had been paying so much attention to Kent, they sensed them and knew he had awakened the Eternal Runes.
"Well, I guess we can finally say he is related to the Chaos Ascension King somehow," Tumenk said, and everyone nodded.
Fiannarel smiled and said,
"That is, if he isn’t the Chaos Ascension King in the first place."
Her words were outrageous, but the seven tribe leaders couldn’t bring themselves to dismiss them.
In fact, they soon started entertaining the idea.
Meanwhile, Kent’s flesh and skin reformed, covering his skeleton.
He then opened his eyes and scanned through the messages.
<You have attained Void Devouring Demon Bones>
<Your Chaos Claws have been upgraded to Chaos Void Devouring Claws>
"All in a year’s work," Kent smiled and turned to the next message, not wanting to waste any time at all.
<You can now move ahead and cultivate the World Root Chaos Scripture>
Kent smiled and began cultivating the fourth technique.
He still had time, but he wasn’t about to waste it on things that wouldn’t benefit him.
The moment he began, the space around him was soon covered with plants and life.
Namarie smiled and crossed her fingers, hoping things turned out well for Kent.
"Although I told him to focus on the life aspect of the World Root Chaos Scripture, if he can handle Death too, I wouldn’t mind.
I wouldn’t mind at all."
Everyone nodded at her words.
After all, they wanted to be free, and if what Jyoti Lata said about the Chaos Ascension King was true, then he needed the complete technique to pass the trial.
So they didn’t care how; they just wanted him to succeed.
Meanwhile, Kent appeared in a garden so vast and endless that he had no idea where it ended.
It was filled with beautiful plants and birds, things that would make one want to stay inside.
However, the moment Kent appeared inside, he felt like he had stepped into the garden of death.
He felt both life and death, and as someone who had seen death many times, he knew this garden was no rainbows and sunshine.
In fact, he became scared at once...
Naturally, his suspicion was confirmed when the message appeared.
<Welcome to the Upside-Down Everlasting Garden.
The way forward is to split yourself in two and comprehend the life and death of all living things>
At once, the method appeared in Kent’s mind, and like a madman, he tapped into it.
That was when he saw it.
His body was split in half, one with green hair and the other with black hair.
The green-haired version remained in the Garden of Life, while the black-haired version appeared in a graveyard with dead trees, tombstones, and an overwhelming amount of death qi.
It appeared the Upside-Down Everlasting Garden had two sides.
One side was filled with life, and when it flipped, the other side became death.
"Well, I guess Lady Namarie would be disappointed that I will be following both paths." He smiled, then closed his eyes, beginning to cultivate both energies.
Inside his soul sea, Lady Kenzie snapped her eyes open, feeling an overwhelming surge of life energy pouring into Kent’s body.
Her eyes sparkled, and without hesitation, she began cultivating it to strengthen herself, which would also strengthen Kent.
On the other side, the Underworld Soul River surged, and the gates opened, revealing a terrifying sea of death.
The death energy being channeled into his body had started entering the gates, refining and strengthening them.
Time soon passed, and before long, a year had passed.
Inside Kent’s soul sea, Lady Kenzie had undergone so many upgrades that she now looked like life itself.
If before she had been a Celestial, then now she had become a Primordial.
She had become different, and the Tree of Life behind her seemed to reveal the kind of monster she had become.
She hovered in the air, facing someone else.
This person was a man with pale white skin and a body covered in tattered black cloth.
His disheveled hair flowed down his back, touching his waist.
A massive skull with glowing red eye sockets hovered imposingly behind him.
This man is Death, or more accurately, the Spirit of Death.
"We are not supposed to be in the same place at the same time," Lady Kenzie said.
The man smiled and nodded.
"Yet here we are, and I think we both know what needs to be done."
Lady Kenzie nodded.
"I do.
So why don’t we get right on that?
I would love to see what Life and Death can achieve when they come together."
"Likewise."
Both moved, and when they met, they placed their palms together and closed their eyes.
On the outside, Namarie widened her eyes, staring at a Yin-Yang diagram appearing behind Kent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1785: Overpowered Techniques (6)
paragraphs: "T-This... is... the Life and Death Tai Chi Diagram," Namarie jumped to her feet, a shocked expression riddling her face. Her hands shook, and for a moment, she turned pale.

If one didn’t understand the depth of her power, they would have mistaken her reaction for fear. However, she was an Eternal, someone far stronger than Kent. She is basically incapable of feeling fear from a weakling like Kent...
So her reaction, while mind-bending, was actually a mix of excitement and shock.

First of all, she had never expected Kent to awaken the Upside-Down Everlasting Garden as his cultivation furnace. Second, she never expected him to cultivate both the Life and Death aspects of the World Root Chaos Scripture.
In fact, she was more shocked that, in just a year, he had cultivated both Life and Death to the full completion of the first form of the World Root Chaos Scripture.
It takes a deeper understanding of Life and Death to achieve even half of what he did, and it would have taken no less than 10,000 years.
"Namarie, a little context would help," Borislav said.
Namarie, who had been lost in her own world, snapped back to reality and answered,
"Long story short, just like with the first three techniques, he also awakened the Upside-Down Everlasting Garden, which is said to hold power over both life and death.

Naturally, we both expected this, so that isn’t much of a shock. However, the first form of the World Root Chaos Scripture concerns comprehending Life and Death and forming either a Tree of Life or a Death Skull.
He had done both, and most importantly, he had merged the two, forming the infamous Life and Death Tai Chi Diagram that only the Chaos Ascension King had wielded.

Basically, the kid has become unkillable, no matter how you look at it. While he is not immune to death yet, what would have taken a million years of effort to kill him a year ago would now take a hundred billion years of effort.

Honestly, I don’t know what he had become after the first three techniques, but now, I think he may just be the first person ever to wield the powers of both life and death to this extent while he hadn’t attained divinity yet..."
Everyone became solemn, unsure of what to even say at this point. In fact, Fiannarel, who seemed to know more about Kent, was now wondering if she really knew anything about him.
’No need. He promised to tell me everything when we return home.’ A smile formed at the corner of her lips. ’I guess we have a lot more to talk about. How exciting.’
If only Kent knew he would soon have a clingy sister who wouldn’t take her eyes off him even for a moment, he would probably ditch her here and never return to get her.

"So, I think I am not the only one wondering this, but if Kent somehow turns out to be the Chaos Ascension King, how are we going to handle things? I know Jyoti Lata has already signed a contract with him, but what about us? Do we do the same, or just accept him as he is... as Kent Madson?" Tumenk asked.
The rest of the Eternals became stunned, everyone turning to look at Kent again.
However, just before Parand could reply, two spheres emerged from Kent’s forehead and manifested into two imposing figures.

Lady Kenzie stood on one side, fields of grass and flowers growing around her, while the darkly clad figure representing Death stood with his arms crossed, a graveyard and scenes of carnage materializing behind him.
When Namarie saw this, she fell back into her seat, pale and trembling, this time from fear.
Misinterpreting this as danger, the other Eternals immediately went into battle mode, their auras flaring to life.
"DON’T!"
However, Namarie’s voice stopped them just before they could make the biggest mistake of their lives.
"They are not our enemies. In fact, they are a miracle, so don’t dare mess with them unless you wish for death at the hands of the Chaos Ascension King."
The Eternals paled, and under their stunned gazes, Namarie went down on her knees and bowed.
"All hail the Sovereign of Life and Death."

Kent, who was seated in a lotus position, slowly opened his eyes. At once, the Eternals saw that one eye, glowing green, contained an overflowing force of Life so vast and boundless that they nearly fell into a trance.

In the other eye, black in color, they saw a dark and twisted plain of Death, unimaginably vast and horrifying by all standards. For a moment, they wondered if Kent had become the embodiment of Death itself.
"Makes me wonder why I never came here sooner," Kent said, stretching his hand. He yawned before adding, "But I must say, Life and Death truly are not something to play with."
He turned and looked at Namarie, who was still on her knees.
"I don’t know why I am here or who I really am. But calling me the Sovereign of Life and Death is a bit of a stretch."
Namarie smiled and responded, almost drooling with joy.
"You don’t understand, Lord Kent. According to the old records, the very day one awakens the Spirit of Life and Death, they shall be known as the Sovereign of Life and Death.
It was said that a very long time ago, a lone figure with no lineage or purpose roamed the Primordial Chaos with power so overwhelming that nobody below or above Existence could contend with him.
They said he was so powerful that the Laws, Daos, and everything in existence bowed at his feet. One day, he came to this world and fought the Chaos Ascension King, just as he had fought many others.

During their battle, the Chaos Ascension King invoked the True Name of Life and Death, hoping to suppress him. After all, the concept of immortality was merely an idea. The cycle of Life and Death is eternal and cannot be avoided.

However, this person overcame it with a mere wave of his hand. When questioned by the Chaos Ascension King, he said he had already transcended Death and claimed Life, so nothing could kill him, not even the overwhelming might of the Chaos Ascension King.
That day, the Chaos Ascension King named him the Paragon, for he had transcended Existence and stood beyond both the known and the unknown, stepping on the Heavenly Dao and everything else.
He also bestowed the power over Life and Death upon the Chaos Ascension King, promising to fight him once again when he finally reached that level.

Years later, they fought again, and it ended in a tie. However, many who witnessed even a fraction of that battle all said one thing... Life and Death dance upon the palm of the Sovereign of Life and Death."

"Wow... chills," Kent muttered, looking at his body. He clearly never expected his achievement to now be attributed to a legendary event that had happened billions, perhaps even trillions, of years ago.
Yet again, it revolved around one person, and that person, of course, was the Paragon. He had met him many times, and each time, the Paragon seemed to impress him somehow.
’Just what are you, Paragon, and what do you want from me?’

For a moment, the idea that he was here because of the Paragon crossed his mind. But that was just impossible, not when he believed he had come here of his own accord because, be that as it may, he now believed might just be the legendary Chaos Ascension King.
