chapters.title: Chapter 1795: The Inheritance
paragraphs: Kent had no idea what the inheritance was. However, he was already convinced that he was the Chaos Ascension King, so he knew the inheritance came from him—the part of himself that had kick-started this whole reincarnation cycle.
Although Paragon had been a bit vague in his explanation, he had made Kent aware that he had once been an existence that stood above all others.

He also hinted that this was a cycle started by Kent himself, and now, he had to finish it by getting ahead of things. This meant that instead of waiting until he became a Primordial before continuing where he had left off, now, he can start the process much earlier.
In the past, he began when he met the paragon. Now, he is starting from the demigod stage.
Something had happened that led to their failure to stop whatever Paragon had asked for help with. However, that failure might also have revealed where he had been lacking.
So he devised a plan to ensure that this time, he would fix that weakness before he reached the point where he would have to face that terror again.
If he could fix it this early and continue improving himself before that meeting, who was to say he wouldn’t be able to rise above whatever obstacle awaited him?
Even now, without the inheritance, Kent could feel that he had broken a limit that was supposed to exist in the first place. He had gone beyond what he was meant to be as a Demigod.
That put him in a good mood, and as he followed Tower toward the inheritance, he couldn’t help but wonder what awaited him and, more importantly, what would become of him after inheriting it.
He let his mind drift from that thought for a moment, focusing on something else...

Looking at Tower, he asked, "I learned that I created the Chaos Chasm and its inhabitants. Since that is the case, can I bring them with me to the Infinity Universe if they are to be housed inside Tower City?"

"Yes," Tower replied, making Kent sigh in relief. "Since the Master is going to reclaim his inheritance, my mission here will end, meaning the Chaos Tower will become whole again. Naturally, everything here is a part of the Tower, so yes, the Master can take them.
But like Lord Paragon said, unless you want to trigger a higher form of war, only some Celestials and those below can be allowed to roam the Universe."

"That is good enough. While I cannot promise that the Tower will be enough to contain them, I believe they have their purpose. So for now, let’s retrieve the inheritance. Then later, we can talk about the best way to make them happy."
He had created them, after all.
After a few more minutes of walking, they arrived at another temple, one with nineteen statues standing before it. At first glance, Kent recognised them.
Six stood on the left, while thirteen stood on the right.

The first person on the left was clearly the Slaughter King, Bhaalzhar. He was one of the Six True Primordials, the man who had given Kent the Bone Tempering Art and the Nine Blood Gate Slaughter Art.

He had already told Kent that their existence was to prepare six special bloodlines that would merge with the Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline. Once that happened, Kent’s true bloodline would awaken.
So far, he had only met Bhaalzhar, but looking at the statues now, he knew the other five were among the True Primordials as well.
Four of them were men, and two were women. But Kent didn’t dwell on them for long, since he knew he would learn more about them soon enough.

The thirteen statues on the right were, of course, his thirteen past lives. Chaos was the first, followed by Jest and the others. So far, he had recalled the memories of nine lives, leaving him with only four more to go.
As for what those thirteen lives had in store for him, aside from extensive battle experience and historical knowledge, he was about to find out.
"I believe the Master has already awakened the Thirteen-Layered Life Discs and the Six-Mark Fate Disc," Tower asked, and Kent nodded.
"I have. Though I have to ask, what do the Thirteen-Layered Life Discs do? I know the Six-Mark Fate Disc has to do with the bloodlines of the Six True Primordials."

"The Thirteen-Layered Life Discs are meant for the classes wielded by your thirteen incarnations. The idea is for the Master to be able to wield all those classes with ease and continue advancing them."

Kent smiled a bit, having suspected this. He had wondered in the past why his other classes weren’t registering in the system. In his opinion, he should have been able to evolve those classes into higher versions.
So the fact that he couldn’t have left him a bit baffled. But now, it appeared he could do it using the Thirteen-Layered Life Discs.
They walked into the building, where only a small golden key hovering above a miniature tower could be seen.
"All the Master has to do is take the key and unlock the tower," Tower instructed, and Kent stepped forward.
He reached for the key and grabbed it. Then he looked at the tower and slowly inserted the key into the keyhole. Kent twisted it counterclockwise, and a lock clicked open.
The moment it did, Kent felt a flood of information pour into his mind as messages filled his vision, causing him to close his eyes and stand there for several minutes.
Kent could feel it. As the information flowed into his mind, he finally sensed a unique connection forming between him and the nine classes he had awakened.
He had been a Brawler during the Primordial Era. After all, most dragons preferred to fight like brutes. But he became a Swordsman during the Divine Era and an Assassin during the Shadow Era.
Then he went on to become many things throughout the ten remaining lives.
Right now, he could sense the connection forming between him and nine classes, showing that the nine lives whose memories he had recalled had now awakened their classes.
He let this sink in, for he understood that, regardless of how much time had passed, his past would always find a way to shape his future.
Now, he had awakened so many classes, and even without moving a finger, he could feel his understanding of them deepening.
It was as though he had always possessed those classes, but now, they had truly become a part of him... He had become their rightful owner.
But that wasn’t all.
He also sensed a very powerful bloodline awaken within him. The moment it did, he felt his main bloodline, the Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline, grow even stronger.
He could still sense that his bloodline awakening remained at 45%. But now he could feel a much deeper power flowing through it than before inheriting his legacy.

Now, he could sense that power coursing through him and, more importantly, his Blood and Slaughter Path had merged with his very being, making him far more connected to who he was meant to be rather than who he had been forced to become.
The process took a couple more minutes. When it ended, Kent smiled and sat in the lotus position to examine everything first.
He understood that once he left this place, he would be walking into a battle that would determine whether he was ready to liberate this universe from the clutches of evil or succumb to them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1796: Path To True Primordial
paragraphs: Kent opened the system interface and began reading the messages that had appeared. He started with the 13 Layered Life Discs because they came with more messages, and he planned to review all of them.
He had failed to name some of his past life classes, so he wanted to see which ones he had missed and what he might have missed back then, since he had no system to check every small change.
<You have absorbed the legacy of the Chaos Ascension King>
<Your 13 Layered Life Discs and Six Mark Fate Disc have activated and are assimilating with the legacy>
<Your 13 Layered Life Discs have assimilated with the Legacy and are extracting the lives you had lived>
<Primordial Chaos Dragon (Chaos) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Chaos Claw Brawler Class>
<Lord Genesis (Jest) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Genesis Swordsman Class>
<Faceless Assassin (Jaqen) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Faceless Assassin Class>
<Ruthless Bandit (Lex) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Grim Evil Spear Mage Class>
<Pill Celestial Kevin Sage extracted ↠ You have awakened the Nine Ascension Mind Demon Class>
<Divine Beast Tamer (Aurelion) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Divine Beast Tamer Class>
<Bone Lich Undead Emperor (Sanders) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Bone Lich Undead Necromancy Class>
<Nine Underworld Flame Blacksmith (Fjorge) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Nine Underworld Flame Blacksmith Class>
<Omniscience Dao Archer (Kalimndra) extracted ↠ You have awakened the Omniscient Dao Archer Class>
Kent looked at the messages, and for a moment, a smile spread across his face. "I have come a long way."
Looking at the first name, Chaos, to the ninth, Kalimndra, the Omniscience Dao Archer, he knew he had come a very long way.
He still had 4 more lives to recall, but with just this one, he knew he could finally face the dangers he had faced in the past and walk away unscathed.
He had failed several times, but now he believed he would succeed, not because he had become much stronger. He knew he would succeed because he now had a sure path to becoming a True Primordial.
Kent tapped on the Chaos Claw Brawler Class to see what it entailed.
[Chaos Claw Brawler Class]
[Legion: Void Legion (Locked)]
[Rank: Celestial+]

[Description: Claws are meant to cut through flesh, tear through bones, and litter battlefields with chaos and mayhem. The Chaos Claw Brawler Class stands as the deadliest Brawler Class in existence. The more the chaos, the stronger it gets, empowering the wielder to cause even more chaos.]
The description wasn’t the most tasteful, but Kent, who had wielded this class before, knew it was on point. The more the chaos, the deadlier the Chaos Claw Brawler Class became.
In the past, the only times he stopped were when there was nothing left to kill or when he had spent all his energy. Now, he would never run out of energy, even if he wanted to.
So the only thing that would cause him to stop was the absence of targets to kill.
Kent was also pleased to see the name of the legion he had assembled during the Primordial Era. He had yet to gather five of them, so it remained locked.
But there was a good chance things would be different soon.
He quickly scanned the rest of his legions and, to his shock, more memories of the lives he had lived flooded his mind, revealing what he had missed.
Lord Genesis formed the 14 Lost Knights. They were his masterpiece since he was the one who saved them, cared for them, and provided them with resources and a path to walk.
Faceless Assassin turned out to have a special legion known as the Forgotten Faceless Agents. This memory had just returned to him, and it was part of how he died during the shadow era.
It turned out that after winning the Shadow Wars, Faceless returned to the Shadow Realm to continue his exploration. While there, he met a group of 45 assassins, each unique in their own way.
They did not know where they came from or where to go. So Faceless made them his agents, and together they explored the Shadow Realm for years until Faceless received the signal to reincarnate.
He left them there but promised to return for them one day.

Kent had always entertained the idea that Faceless had the largest legion since he created the Midnight Shadows. But now, he had discovered the true shadow legion, and they are waiting for him inside the Shadow Realm.
Ruthless Bandit had the Night Riders. While they were already a team, his arrival had forced them to grow stronger and become better versions of themselves.

Kevin Sage had also formed the Eternal Wrath Legion. It was a team of unnamed heroes from hundreds of races. He gathered them, provided for them and using his extensive knowledge, made them into a legion of deadly warriors.
Divine Beast Tamer formed the Thirteen Divine Wonders, of which Yukiko is a member. They are a team of 13 powerful Overlord Beasts, each with a unique talent.
Of course, they were dangerous and unique.

They were the leaders of the Beast Legion. But unlike Faceless, who saw the Midnight Shadows as only an organisation, the Divine Beast Tamer saw all his beasts as a legion, and the universe recognised them all, making them his largest legion yet.
Nine Underworld Flame Blacksmith, of course, formed the Hell Devastators. They were the champions of the Damnation Arena, the same arena he had dominated.
Bone Lich Undead Emperor, of course, formed the Undead Legion.

As for the Omniscience Dao Archer, he formed the legendary Sky Legion. They were a team of powerful archers formed from rejected Elven warriors. They had failed to join any of the Elven armies, so Kalimndra took them in and trained them.
Memories of every last one of them had returned to him. Now, all that remained was finding them, which he knew would eventually happen.
Kent sighed, then focused on the next set of messages.
<Your Six Mark Fate Disc has assimilated with the Legacy and is extracting the Six Primal Bloodlines>
<Blood Calamity Slaughter King Bloodline extracted>
<Do you want to assimilate with this bloodline and make it yours?>
<Error: You have yet to make contact with the remaining True Primordials. Failed to extract bloodlines>
"I suppose meeting the rest should be on my next itinerary," Kent chuckled. His focus on the message showed that he had successfully extracted the Slaughter King’s bloodline.
He turned and looked at the real Tower.
"What will happen if I initiate the assimilation?"

"The Master will unlock the main Limitless Technique that came with the Blood Calamity Slaughter King Bloodline. The Master will then be required to comprehend it, which can take some time. However, when it is over, the Master’s main bloodline will become stronger."
"That is good. Then tell me, for the mission to kill the Dark Empress, can I take my sister with me, or some of the people from the Chaos Chasm?"

Yet again, Tower nodded. "The Master can take Lady Fiannarel with him. However, she will be suppressed to the Celestial Stage. Aside from that, the Master can also make the seven tribe leaders his Blood Warriors. While they will be suppressed, they can still be of great help."
"Take more than that, and the Heavenly Dao will break, exposing the universe to all kinds of threats."
Kent smiled upon hearing this. "Then kindly inform them of the latest development. If they accept, bring them here."
"As you command, Master."
Tower vanished, and Kent initiated the bloodline assimilation process...

chapters.title: Chapter 1797: Blood Sea Annihilation
paragraphs: Since Kent had made up his mind to proceed with assimilating his bloodline, he wasted no time and decided to initiate the process immediately. The faster he gets things done, the sooner he gets to return home to his loves.
After all, he had just discovered he was the Chaos Ascension King.
While he knew nothing about that part of his life, so far, he had seen and heard enough to know he was someone very powerful.
Most importantly, he now had a way to know more about what truly happened leading to the events that kick-started his 13 reincarnations.

The only thing hindering him now was how to open the book containing that information. Everything he needed to know was in the book he had received from Tower. As for how he would open it, Tower only said the book would open on its own.
Kent hated the uncertainty, so he wanted to know everything now and, hopefully, plan ahead for what was to come after everything was over.
’Ahh, this suspense is killing me,’ Kent smirked, then pressed "Yes."
<You have initiated Bloodline Assimilation>
<Blood Calamity Slaughter King Bloodline is merging with the Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline>
<You have unlocked a Limitless Grade Bloodline Technique: Blood Sea Annihilation>
He dove into the technique and began to learn it. With the cultivation arts he had learned from the seven tribes, it was about time he learned a worthy martial technique, too.
While the seven techniques include some martial techniques, he needs a Limitless-grade technique meant for martial combat only.
Luckily for him, this technique was terrifying by all standards.
It had no forms or levels like most techniques. Instead, it just required blood, soul, and control.
The blood was the source of the technique. When activated, it would draw out the blood sea inside Kent’s soul sea, causing a vast crimson sea to rise into the air.

Then, with his soul, Kent could imbue any form of energy into it. If he wanted, he could go with Chaos Qi, Abyssal Qi, flame, ice, or just go bananas and imbue all of them, provided his soul could handle it.

Then, if he managed to do that, the rest was control. He could shape the blood sea into just about anything and use it to attack. He could transform it into a large sword, spear, scythe, thousands of swords, millions of arrows... anything at all he could control.
Basically, he could transform it into a domain of blood where, if he mastered any law, he could imbue it, thereby making it his own.
So he could imbue his Genesis Sword Domain, when he awakened it, into the Domain of Blood, causing a much stronger mutation to take place.

"With my classes awakened and now as a Demigod, I can unleash my domains that don’t deal with unique mastery," he smiled, knowing that, aside from his Sword Domain, the rest of the domains he wielded in the past could now be unleashed.
"Merging them with this Blood Sea Annihilation sure would prove catastrophic."
And that was the main reason why anything Kent touched turned into a deadlier version of itself.
He always found a way to bring out the worst version of anything, especially techniques.
What could be considered a tamed and basic form of anything in Kent’s hands became a deadly weapon, one that could claim lives on a much larger scale.

He took a deep breath and began making mental plans for how to use this technique in the upcoming battle. After all, he was going against an opponent who probably had millions of minions under her command.

Be that as it may, he alone could not handle them, and since the Undead Legion and Night Riders were away on a mission when he left, he might only be able to summon the Beast Legion and probably his wives.
For now, he wanted to keep his options open, so he asked Tower to go fetch his sister and the tribe leaders.
Fiannarel was from the Infinity Universe, so suppressing her cultivation base wouldn’t cause too much trouble. However, the others were the outliers.
Tower said he could make them his Blood Warriors—a unique attribute that would activate after completing bloodline assimilation.
By making them his Blood Warriors, he could, at will, lower their cultivation bases to the Celestial Stage so they could help him.
He couldn’t do that for the others, but if what Tower said turned out to be the case, then he could bring the people of the Chaos Chasm back to the tower to live there for now.
Kent could already tell that the universe would soon undergo a trial, and that, depending on whether they won, something would change. When that happened, he could let them roam the universe.
For now, he just wanted them not to get their expectations too high.
His mind was soon occupied by the technique, his growing bloodline, and the plans for what he would do next after leaving this place.

Meanwhile, on the outside, after an hour had passed and Kent still wasn’t out, everyone’s mood brightened. This was the first time in their lives that someone had lasted that long inside the Chaos Ascension King Trial.
So while they had no idea what was happening inside the trial, they believed Kent was doing well, and so there was a chance he might just succeed.
To them, their freedom was almost there.
The moment the portal fluttered and someone walked out, everyone became ecstatic. They all expected Kent to walk out with good news. However, when they saw Tower walk out, some frowned.

Tower stopped a few steps away from the portal and, perhaps seeing the expressions on their faces, smiled and chose to first wipe away their worries. "First of all, you all have nothing to worry about. Master is perfectly fine, and he is still inside the Chaos Ascension King Trial."
They sighed, but then some picked up on a few details and asked, "Master... who is your master?"
Tower replied, "My name is Celestial Chaos Tower, personal assistant to the Chaos Ascension King. I am also the Temple Guardian and the guardian of the Chaos Chasm.
The person I referred to as Master is naturally Kent Madson."
"WHAT?"
"Are you saying Kent Madson is the Chaos Ascension King?" Zdzislav asked in a shocked tone.
"I believe that is what I said. Kent Madson is the Chaos Ascension King." Tower looked amused, staring at the expressions on everyone’s faces.

They were clearly in shock, learning that what they had already suspected was actually the truth. Kent was the person they had all been waiting for to free them. The person who created their world and made them who they are now.
They wanted it to be Kent, but now that they had found out it was indeed him, none of them could believe their ears.
Fiannarel smiled happily, hearing what Tower had just said about her baby brother. "So baby brother is indeed the Chaos Ascension King," she muttered, almost emotional.
Tower replied to her with a charming smile, "Yes, Master was always the Chaos Ascension King, and he sent me to come fetch you."
"Really?" Fiannarel’s eyes sparkled.

"Yes. In fact, he wants me to bring the seven tribe chiefs too. He has something to discuss with the seven of you," Tower revealed her reason for coming, and as expected, aside from Fiannarel, who was extremely happy, the rest were in shock.
However, they knew they had to heed the call, considering the one summoning them was the Chaos Ascension King. They had no reason to reject his call, after all.
So they left with her, eager to meet the Chaos Ascension King, who now went by Kent Madson, the Primordial Chaos Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1798: Blood Warriors...Big Boon
paragraphs: "This place is..." Fiannarel asked, looking around the vast forest, teeming with all kinds of laws, Dao, and everything a cultivator needs.
She could sense the unique nature of this place, and so could the seven tribe leaders.
"How is this even possible?" Zdzislav muttered, a shocked expression spreading across his face. "It is like, just by breathing, my comprehension of the Eternal Dao and laws starts to deepen0-."
"Indeed. Is this the source of power that always seems to improve the talent of anyone who takes the trial?" Jyoti Lata asked, and Tower answered.

"Indeed. Master created this cultivation ground a very long time ago. Using his extensive knowledge when it comes to the laws and Dao, he rewrote the very core of the existence of this place. Now, just by breathing, one’s talent improves."

"That... Just how strong would one have to be to rewrite the laws of existence?" Parand was left dumbfounded. She just couldn’t wrap her mind around the fact that just breathing here was all it took to improve one’s cultivation talent.
Tower smiled, shaking her head, almost as if what the eight Eternals were experiencing was merely an ordinary Tuesday for her.

She had been with the Chaos Ascension King for trillions of years and had witnessed all kinds of mind-blowing things, so their shock wasn’t something new to her. She had been shocked before, and more importantly, she had had her fair share of shocking encounters while following Kent.

So she was no longer even going to pretend to be shocked. To her, whatever Kent did from here onwards wasn’t new. Even if he did something so mind-bending, she would just see it as one of the many mind-blowing things he would keep doing as long as he lived.

"It would probably be good if you all could keep an open mind. After all, when it comes to Master, only seven others can measure up, and they each have their fair share of mind-blowing creations and encounters.

You would have a much better time around him by keeping an open mind than letting every small thing break your mind. Trust me, I have witnessed him do one mind-blowing thing after another, like it was a normal morning."
They nodded, but taking her words to heart and putting them into practice would take some time. To them, this was just too mind-blowing to even consider.
Kent, who had been hard at work for a couple of hours, finally let a smile form on his face as the bloodline assimilation finally ended.
<Bloodline Assimilation Complete.>
<Congratulations, your Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline has been upgraded from Celestial+ ↠ Primordial>
<You have awakened a Bloodline Ability: Blood Warrior>
[Blood Warrior]
[Rank: Innate]

[Description: The Life Blood of the worthy can transform the ordinary into the extraordinary, and the extraordinary into an existence beyond comprehension. You are worthy to awaken the long-lost Blood Warrior lineage.]
[Blood Warriors: 0/7]

"Looks like I still have a lot to do before my bloodline can move from 45% to 50%." Kent had expected such a breakthrough, but now it appeared he would have to wait and use blood essence rather than temper it.
"But this is good. At least I can now use more of my bloodline in combat." He let a smile form on his face.
Finally, he could leave this place and put an end to the tyranny of the Dark Empress. "I do hope the people backing her make themselves known so I can put them down for good."
He stood up and walked toward a pavilion where Tower and the eight people he had asked her to bring were seated.

When they saw him approach, they all jumped to their feet, and Fiannarel ran into Kent’s arms. He may be the Chaos Ascension King to the natives of the Chaos Chasm, but to her, he was her baby brother.
Kent smiled, seeing how spoiled she was acting. "Big sister, you do know you are too old to be acting like this..."
She smirked but didn’t let go of him. Kent just shook his head, and after she pulled back, he moved to the pavilion, holding her hand.
"We greet the Chaos Ascension King," the seven tribe leaders said as they went down on their knees and bowed.
"You guys don’t have to do that. I may be the Chaos Ascension King, but now, I am merely a Chaos Dragon with Demigod-level strength," Kent said, taking a seat.

The seven tribe leaders lifted their heads and looked back at him. "Even though you are only a Demigod at the moment, we still see you as the Chaos Ascension King," Parand said, making a determined fist.

To them, the Chaos Ascension King was the law, and they had all grown up learning to respect and admire him. So, Demigod or not, Kent was their ruler, and giving him the respect he deserved was only right.
"Regardless, you all have to sit down first before I can reveal why I summoned you here."
They nodded, bowed, and stood up, each taking their seat. Fiannarel had already seated herself beside Kent, looking very happy. Having Kent back was all she had ever wanted.

"I never expected to be the one you all keep talking about. However, now that I have regained my identity, I would first like to point out that I can indeed free you all. However, there is a catch..."
They all smiled. "Whatever the catch may be, as long as we can gain our freedom, we are willing to pay," Tumenk stated, and the rest gave a supportive nod.
"Tumenk is right. We are willing to pay any price for our freedom," Jyoti Lata said.
Kent just smiled and said,

"There is no price to be paid. The catch is that my universe is still too weak, so allowing you guys in is impossible. It will break the rules and allow dangers far beyond what even you guys can handle to come in.

That said, I have a pocket dimension where you all can stay and interact with the people I have already migrated there. Also, I am not entirely sure, but I believe that when I leave here, the pocket dimension will evolve and merge with this world, allowing me to transport the Chaos Chasm there while keeping your homes intact.

I also have a feeling you guys have a much bigger mission that will reveal itself when I get back to my universe. So there will be more exploration to do, and I do hope it will be enough to satisfy your expectations."

Kent could tell by the looks on their faces that they were more than satisfied. He could even tell that if he asked them to remain here for a few more million years while he worked to make the Infinity Universe ready for them to roam, they wouldn’t complain.
That shows how much trust they have in him.
"We are okay with everything you have planned, Lord Kent," Namarie said with a nod.
Kent smiled and nodded back. "That aside, I have another reason for asking for you seven to be brought here. You see..."
Seven days later, the seven tribe leaders stood before Kent, their eyes and hair crimson, each radiating an intense blood aura.
<You have created the first Blood Warrior. Your bloodline grows stronger>
<You have created the second Blood Warrior. Your bloodline grows stronger>
<You have created the third Blood Warrior. Your bloodline grows stronger>
<Your Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline is now 57% awakened>

sentences.text: "This place is..." Fiannarel asked, looking around the vast forest, teeming with all kinds of laws, Dao, and everything a cultivator needs.
She could sense the unique nature of this place, and so could the seven tribe leaders.
"How is this even possible?" Zdzislav muttered, a shocked expression spreading across his face.
"It is like, just by breathing, my comprehension of the Eternal Dao and laws starts to deepen0-."
"Indeed.
Is this the source of power that always seems to improve the talent of anyone who takes the trial?" Jyoti Lata asked, and Tower answered.
"Indeed.
Master created this cultivation ground a very long time ago.
Using his extensive knowledge when it comes to the laws and Dao, he rewrote the very core of the existence of this place.
Now, just by breathing, one’s talent improves."
"That...
Just how strong would one have to be to rewrite the laws of existence?" Parand was left dumbfounded.
She just couldn’t wrap her mind around the fact that just breathing here was all it took to improve one’s cultivation talent.
Tower smiled, shaking her head, almost as if what the eight Eternals were experiencing was merely an ordinary Tuesday for her.
She had been with the Chaos Ascension King for trillions of years and had witnessed all kinds of mind-blowing things, so their shock wasn’t something new to her.
She had been shocked before, and more importantly, she had had her fair share of shocking encounters while following Kent.
So she was no longer even going to pretend to be shocked.
To her, whatever Kent did from here onwards wasn’t new.
Even if he did something so mind-bending, she would just see it as one of the many mind-blowing things he would keep doing as long as he lived.
"It would probably be good if you all could keep an open mind.
After all, when it comes to Master, only seven others can measure up, and they each have their fair share of mind-blowing creations and encounters.
You would have a much better time around him by keeping an open mind than letting every small thing break your mind.
Trust me, I have witnessed him do one mind-blowing thing after another, like it was a normal morning."
They nodded, but taking her words to heart and putting them into practice would take some time.
To them, this was just too mind-blowing to even consider.
Kent, who had been hard at work for a couple of hours, finally let a smile form on his face as the bloodline assimilation finally ended.
<Bloodline Assimilation Complete.>
<Congratulations, your Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline has been upgraded from Celestial+ ↠ Primordial>
<You have awakened a Bloodline Ability: Blood Warrior>
[Blood Warrior]
[Rank: Innate]
[Description: The Life Blood of the worthy can transform the ordinary into the extraordinary, and the extraordinary into an existence beyond comprehension.
You are worthy to awaken the long-lost Blood Warrior lineage.]
[Blood Warriors: 0/7]

"Looks like I still have a lot to do before my bloodline can move from 45% to 50%." Kent had expected such a breakthrough, but now it appeared he would have to wait and use blood essence rather than temper it.
"But this is good.
At least I can now use more of my bloodline in combat." He let a smile form on his face.
Finally, he could leave this place and put an end to the tyranny of the Dark Empress.
"I do hope the people backing her make themselves known so I can put them down for good."
He stood up and walked toward a pavilion where Tower and the eight people he had asked her to bring were seated.
When they saw him approach, they all jumped to their feet, and Fiannarel ran into Kent’s arms.
He may be the Chaos Ascension King to the natives of the Chaos Chasm, but to her, he was her baby brother.
Kent smiled, seeing how spoiled she was acting.
"Big sister, you do know you are too old to be acting like this..."
She smirked but didn’t let go of him.
Kent just shook his head, and after she pulled back, he moved to the pavilion, holding her hand.
"We greet the Chaos Ascension King," the seven tribe leaders said as they went down on their knees and bowed.
"You guys don’t have to do that.
I may be the Chaos Ascension King, but now, I am merely a Chaos Dragon with Demigod-level strength," Kent said, taking a seat.
The seven tribe leaders lifted their heads and looked back at him.
"Even though you are only a Demigod at the moment, we still see you as the Chaos Ascension King," Parand said, making a determined fist.
To them, the Chaos Ascension King was the law, and they had all grown up learning to respect and admire him.
So, Demigod or not, Kent was their ruler, and giving him the respect he deserved was only right.
"Regardless, you all have to sit down first before I can reveal why I summoned you here."
They nodded, bowed, and stood up, each taking their seat.
Fiannarel had already seated herself beside Kent, looking very happy.
Having Kent back was all she had ever wanted.
"I never expected to be the one you all keep talking about.
However, now that I have regained my identity, I would first like to point out that I can indeed free you all.
However, there is a catch..."
They all smiled.
"Whatever the catch may be, as long as we can gain our freedom, we are willing to pay," Tumenk stated, and the rest gave a supportive nod.
"Tumenk is right.
We are willing to pay any price for our freedom," Jyoti Lata said.
Kent just smiled and said,
"There is no price to be paid.
The catch is that my universe is still too weak, so allowing you guys in is impossible.
It will break the rules and allow dangers far beyond what even you guys can handle to come in.
That said, I have a pocket dimension where you all can stay and interact with the people I have already migrated there.

Also, I am not entirely sure, but I believe that when I leave here, the pocket dimension will evolve and merge with this world, allowing me to transport the Chaos Chasm there while keeping your homes intact.
I also have a feeling you guys have a much bigger mission that will reveal itself when I get back to my universe.
So there will be more exploration to do, and I do hope it will be enough to satisfy your expectations."
Kent could tell by the looks on their faces that they were more than satisfied.
He could even tell that if he asked them to remain here for a few more million years while he worked to make the Infinity Universe ready for them to roam, they wouldn’t complain.
That shows how much trust they have in him.
"We are okay with everything you have planned, Lord Kent," Namarie said with a nod.
Kent smiled and nodded back.
"That aside, I have another reason for asking for you seven to be brought here.
You see..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1799: The Dark War (1)
paragraphs: [Infinity Universe - Somewhere in the Supreme Realm]
Just like how there are five galaxies in the Immortal Realm and the God Realm, the same structure can be found in the Supreme Realm.
However, compared to the number of planets contained in each galaxy in the Immortal Realm or the God Realm, the Supreme Realm is still lacking.
The supreme realm has a smaller number of planets compared to the god realm.
However, a planet in the Supreme Realm is large enough to fit dozens of planets in the Immortal Realm or even the God Realm.
These planets are filled with Supreme Qi, and most importantly, the Laws and Dao can be felt more closely here, especially the Heavenly Laws.
If a god were to live in any of the Supreme Worlds, their progress in comprehending the Laws would be much faster than that of gods in the God Realm.
This is why gods in the Supreme Realm are much stronger than those in the God Realm.

Today, in the Western Supreme Galaxy, on a planet declared by the Jian Great Family as off-limits to anyone, a portal opened, and a young man clad in a black cloak with flowing purple hair streaked with golden and red strands walked out, munching on an apple.
Well, it looks like an apple, but it contains Origin Dao, the same Dao that Pseudo-Primordials and Primordials alike would kill to even smell.
This young man, of course, is Kent.
He had finally handled everything there was to handle inside the Chaos Chasm and decided to come handle the threat of the Dark Empress before anything else.

The moment he stepped out, a powerful pressure came from the heavens and pressed down on him. Kent lifted his head and saw that, up in the clouds, a Supreme formation had activated, probably to prevent others from entering this planet.
Somehow, he had entered, and so it was now acting against him.

He smirked and lifted his left index finger, pointing it upward. A red lightning bolt formed at the tip of his finger, then with a deadly shot, he landed a clean hit on the core of the formation, shattering it in an instant.
Normally, a Supreme formation with close to a hundred layers of arrays is extremely difficult to tamper with, let alone shatter its core.
However, with a mere glance, Kent spotted the core and destroyed it as if it weren’t a big deal.

"As expected, humans are aiding the Dark Queen," Kent muttered coldly, examining some of the runes raining down from the heavens. "Hmm, when I am done with the Dark Empress, I will be sure to visit all of you and wipe every last one of you off the face of this universe."
His killing intent seeped out, causing the surrounding green grass to wilt.
His gaze narrowed, and then a frown appeared on his face...
"Who is that?" Kent raised his gaze, where an old man clad in a simple red robe appeared, holding a walking stick.
He looked simple on the surface, but with his keen perception, Kent could tell this man was deadly...

He is a Supreme King with an extremely deep understanding of the Flame Dao, from what Kent could see, at least. Kent wasn’t intimidated by his overflowing aura. Even if he turns out to be a Celestial, he wouldn’t flinch.
While this is a Supreme World, Celestials can roam freely here, unlike in the Immortal Realm, where they would be suppressed.
The only downside is replenishing their essence. They would have to convert Supreme Qi into Celestial Qi, which takes a lot of time.
But they can roam freely, and right now, a Supreme King had appeared here when Kent hadn’t even met the main target he came here to kill.

The man looked directly at him and asked, "Little man, I believe this place is off-limits to others, so why don’t you turn around and leave before you find yourself in trouble you cannot walk away from?"

His voice was calm, a bit too calm for someone who was supposed to be angry or even wary, considering someone had broken into a planet nobody, aside from perhaps him and a few others, should know about.
This told Kent what he needed to know.
His Omniscient Dao Eyes appraised the man, and his name was revealed to him...
"So you are from the Jian Great Family, huh, old man? Or do you prefer I call you Li Jian?"
Kent’s words changed the old man’s expression. However, Kent’s next words caused his aura to rise into the air, spreading across the planet...
"It appears your Jian Family has been hiding and aiding the Dark Empress, huh?"
The moment Li Jian’s aura erupted, Kent sensed millions of auras coming from a place far from where they were. This made him smile, and he took a bite out of his apple.

"You know what, I never expected sane people to shield such a terror and abomination. I mean, she and her people killed billions during the Dark Era, and they are going to kill billions more. Even if you are rotten at heart, aiding such a creature should be the last thing you would do.
But I guess, while some seek to save the universe, others want to destroy it. In that case, I will destroy you and everything you hold dear."
Li Jian’s aura had, at this moment, spread everywhere, pressing down on Kent, who stood calm, his expression still plain, almost as if he wasn’t under the suppression of a Supreme King.
"Kid, I don’t know where you get your confidence from, but I will kill you and make sure not even your soul makes it to the underworld."
"Is that so?" Kent smirked.
Then he raised his right index finger again and drew a thick line in the air. A few seconds later, divine essence started to surge from it.
Li Jian’s expression darkened, and he grew pale when he sensed a very deep, dense Divine Qi beginning to flow from the line Kent had drawn.
Realizing he might have looked down on Kent, he extended his walking stick, which transformed into a spear. He channeled Supreme Qi into it, then charged forward, arriving before Kent in an instant.
"DIE!"

He stabbed his spear at Kent, causing the very space around them to crack and collapse on itself. The pressure behind the spear was so terrifying that before it even reached Kent, the space behind him collapsed, exposing the void.
Yet despite this danger, Kent merely smiled. Then, using his thumb and index finger, he touched the line he had drawn, which wrapped itself around his index finger.
Then, with a simple gesture, he pointed his index finger forward, meeting the spear in what could be considered the most effortless collision in the history of cultivation.
The spear stopped at the tip of his index finger, and the shockwave that followed blasted the space around them, causing Kent’s hair to billow in the air.
A smirk formed on his face. Then, with a fluid motion, he bit into the apple and munched on it.
"You know, I hate it when people look down on me, old man. For your punishment..."
Kent’s eyes flashed red, then a beam shot out, and two holes appeared in Li Jian’s forehead.
His body was blasted backward, and for a moment, he lost his senses, failing to register what had just happened. But that moment of delay was all Kent needed to end his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800: The Dark War (2)
paragraphs: Kent extended his hand forward, then made a grabbing motion. With just that simple motion, the space around Li Jian shattered, and a giant hand formed from Divine Qi grabbed hold of him.
Despite possessing Supreme Qi, Kent, with his deeper understanding of Divine Qi, decided to use just that. The results, however, were as he expected.
"Die knowing your family and everyone in bed with the Dark Empress will soon follow."
Kent applied pressure, and the giant hand holding Li Jian clenched, crushing him.

Li Jian tried to struggle free, but he discovered his cultivation had been sealed, making it impossible to even move his hand. The only energy left within him was the Qi that had remained inside his meridians before the seal took effect.

It appeared the Eye of Chaos wasn’t just for show after all. Kent had only scratched the surface of his abilities, but he had discovered that as long as his soul strength was stronger than his target’s, he could seal them with a decisive beam.

Li Jian was unfortunate enough to possess a weaker soul than Kent’s. Aside from that, he had also failed to sense Kent’s sudden attack, considering he was still in shock over how effortlessly Kent had blocked his spear strike.
Now, he could sense that his cultivation base had been sealed, making it impossible to free himself from Kent’s grip.
"Brat, do you think killing me will save you from my Jian Family?" Li Jian shouted. Then an item flew out of his space ring and exploded, sending sparks flying into the air.
Kent ignored it and simply replied to the threat, "What makes you think I would let them off? If they come, then death is the only thing that awaits them. As for you... die now."
His grip tightened, and like shattered glass, Li Jian’s body exploded...

Kent watched his soul shatter, and a smile formed on his face. Had he not sealed Li Jian’s cultivation, his soul would have tried to escape. But Kent had anticipated that and chose the most effective way to kill him, and it worked.
"Never underestimate your opponent, no matter how weak they may appear to be," he smirked before turning his attention to the auras rushing toward him.

Within a few minutes, thousands of Dark Fiends, each radiating the power of Demigods and Gods, surrounded Kent. Then more started to appear, filling the skies. Soon, Supreme-level Dark Fiends arrived, and without much delay, Celestials also filled the space.
Millions, perhaps tens of millions, of Dark Fiends now occupied the skies, the overwhelming pressure they emitted pressing heavily down on Kent.
He, of course, remained calm, his gaze slowly sweeping across the lineup of Dark Fiends.
Suddenly, a far more powerful Dark Fiend with pale human skin and unicorn-like horns, radiating the power of a peak Celestial, stepped out of the void, bringing with her an overwhelming pressure.
She scanned Kent from head to toe before asking in a language he understood...
Well, Kent understood every language that existed and every language yet to come.
"You are here to do what exactly, dragon?"
Kent narrowed his eyes at her, and for a brief moment, a hint of coldness flashed across them.

"Sending a Dark Queen to do your bidding, I see." He laughed. "Dark Empress, I am here to kill you, so maybe stop hiding and show yourself. Killing you will save me the hassle of dispatching this entire lineup of Dark Fiends."
Indeed, by killing the Dark Empress, every last Dark Fiend would instantly drop dead. So her appearance would indeed make things much easier for Kent.
Of course, Kent knew she wouldn’t fall for such a simple provocation, but he had to try anyway. Maybe she would.
But he was mistaken.
"If you alone have come to kill the Dark Empress, then I am afraid you will fall today."
Just as the Dark Queen finished speaking, a powerful pressure erupted from Kent’s left as ten Supreme-level Dark Fiends charged at him.
He smiled and shook his head.
"What a hassle."
His foot gently tapped the ground, and tapping into the World Root Chaos Scripture, root tendrils burst from the earth, stabbing into the heads and bodies of the ten Dark Fiends.
"Devour."
With a single command, the energy within their bodies was devoured, causing them to lose all momentum before slamming into the ground, dead on the spot.
"Let’s just say killing all of you will make me stronger. So why not? I am eager to test my limits anyway." Kent grinned...
"KILL HIM!"
Thousands of Dark Fiends surged toward Kent, their body parts morphing into all kinds of weapons. They had come to kill, and so they charged forward without hesitation.

In response, Kent tapped the space between his eyebrows, and for a brief moment, he closed his eyes. Then, with a gentle press of his finger against his forehead, a powerful fluctuation rippled through the air.
Just then, a vertical eye opened on his forehead, causing a beam to shoot high into the heavens.
BUZZZZ
The heavens turned crimson as the clouds parted, revealing a massive eye that seemed to cover the entire sky. The moment it appeared, every last Dark Fiend felt their bodies tense.
Then they sensed danger as thousands of beams began to rain down from the eye.

Kent had decided to begin this terrifying battle with the Eye of Chaos. The battle would probably last for quite a while, considering he could already sense even greater dangers hidden just beyond his perception, slowly making their way toward him.
He had yet to even scratch the surface of the Eye of Chaos, but he knew that using just this much of its power would be more than enough to deal with this many targets...
Thousands began dying every second, yet more kept coming.

Suddenly, one Supreme-level Dark Fiend slipped through the bombardment of the Eye of Chaos and closed in on him. However, before it could get close, Kent unleashed a bolt of lightning from his fingertip, shattering every bone in its chest as a gaping hole appeared through its torso.
More managed to evade the Eye of Chaos, but they were swiftly dealt with.
Kent stole a few seconds to look at the message before him.
<Your Limitless Chaos Tower is undergoing a True Awakening. Time until completion: 1hr 25mins>
Kent smiled, knowing that for the next hour and twenty-five minutes, he would have to hold back the Dark Empress and her army of Dark Fiends.
He was in the Infinity Universe, but he could not reach any of his legion simply because the tower was undergoing an awakening that would allow him to merge the Chaos Chasm with it.
This also meant that until it was complete, he could not summon his sister, Fiannarel, who was probably worried about him. The same for his seven Blood Warriors.
He knew his legion was still too weak for this battle. But he wanted them to come anyway, if only to get a taste of what they would soon be facing.
For now, he could only hold his own against the millions of Dark Fiends.

Meanwhile, far away on a planet owned by the Jian Great Family, everything was in shambles. Thousands of warriors, the majority of them at the God and Demigod stages, began rushing toward a space channel where enormous warships remained suspended in the air, with some already ascending into the passage.
"What is going on?" a Demigod who had just been woken from his sleep asked.
"Haven’t you heard? Lord Li Jian has fallen on the unnamed planet, and the Patriarch wants everyone dispatched there."
The God who answered grabbed his sword and jumped onto the window frame. "We are under attack by someone—or perhaps several people—powerful enough to kill a Supreme King."
He jumped out and quickly made his way toward the space channel...

His foot gently tapped the ground, and tapping into the World Root Chaos Scripture, root tendrils burst from the earth, stabbing into the heads and bodies of the ten Dark Fiends.
"Devour."
With a single command, the energy within their bodies was devoured, causing them to lose all momentum before slamming into the ground, dead on the spot.
"Let’s just say killing all of you will make me stronger.
So why not?
I am eager to test my limits anyway." Kent grinned...
"KILL HIM!"
Thousands of Dark Fiends surged toward Kent, their body parts morphing into all kinds of weapons.
They had come to kill, and so they charged forward without hesitation.
In response, Kent tapped the space between his eyebrows, and for a brief moment, he closed his eyes.
Then, with a gentle press of his finger against his forehead, a powerful fluctuation rippled through the air.
Just then, a vertical eye opened on his forehead, causing a beam to shoot high into the heavens.
BUZZZZ
The heavens turned crimson as the clouds parted, revealing a massive eye that seemed to cover the entire sky.
The moment it appeared, every last Dark Fiend felt their bodies tense.
Then they sensed danger as thousands of beams began to rain down from the eye.
Kent had decided to begin this terrifying battle with the Eye of Chaos.
The battle would probably last for quite a while, considering he could already sense even greater dangers hidden just beyond his perception, slowly making their way toward him.
He had yet to even scratch the surface of the Eye of Chaos, but he knew that using just this much of its power would be more than enough to deal with this many targets...
Thousands began dying every second, yet more kept coming.
Suddenly, one Supreme-level Dark Fiend slipped through the bombardment of the Eye of Chaos and closed in on him.
However, before it could get close, Kent unleashed a bolt of lightning from his fingertip, shattering every bone in its chest as a gaping hole appeared through its torso.
More managed to evade the Eye of Chaos, but they were swiftly dealt with.
Kent stole a few seconds to look at the message before him.
<Your Limitless Chaos Tower is undergoing a True Awakening.
Time until completion: 1hr 25mins>
Kent smiled, knowing that for the next hour and twenty-five minutes, he would have to hold back the Dark Empress and her army of Dark Fiends.
He was in the Infinity Universe, but he could not reach any of his legion simply because the tower was undergoing an awakening that would allow him to merge the Chaos Chasm with it.
This also meant that until it was complete, he could not summon his sister, Fiannarel, who was probably worried about him.
The same for his seven Blood Warriors.
He knew his legion was still too weak for this battle.
But he wanted them to come anyway, if only to get a taste of what they would soon be facing.
For now, he could only hold his own against the millions of Dark Fiends.
Meanwhile, far away on a planet owned by the Jian Great Family, everything was in shambles.

Thousands of warriors, the majority of them at the God and Demigod stages, began rushing toward a space channel where enormous warships remained suspended in the air, with some already ascending into the passage.
"What is going on?" a Demigod who had just been woken from his sleep asked.
"Haven’t you heard?
Lord Li Jian has fallen on the unnamed planet, and the Patriarch wants everyone dispatched there."
The God who answered grabbed his sword and jumped onto the window frame.
"We are under attack by someone—or perhaps several people—powerful enough to kill a Supreme King."
He jumped out and quickly made his way toward the space channel...
